title: Experienced Cold Caller / Apoointment Setter - Remote
description:
Experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Remote



We’re hiring an experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to join our growing team and handle outbound calling campaigns on behalf of our clients.



Our clients primarily work with small and mid-sized trades businesses across North America, including contractors, HVAC companies, electricians, plumbers, and other home-service and trades businesses.



You’ll be representing our clients on the phone, speaking directly with business owners, identifying qualified opportunities, and booking appointments.



This is a phone-first position. We are looking for someone who is already comfortable cold calling and knows how to have a natural conversation rather than simply reading a script.



What You’ll Do



Make outbound cold calls on behalf of our clients

Complete approximately 3–4 hours of active cold calling per working day

Speak directly with business owners throughout the US and Canada

Follow provided scripts, offers, and qualification criteria

Ask the right questions to determine whether a prospect is qualified

Handle objections confidently and naturally

Keep conversations moving without sounding scripted or robotic

Book qualified appointments

Accurately record call outcomes, notes, and appointments in our CRM

Represent our company and our clients professionally on every call



What We’re Looking For 



Minimum 1+ years of proven cold calling or appointment-setting experience

Previous experience calling US, Canadian, Australian, or other English-speaking markets is a strong advantage

Excellent spoken English with clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation

Confident and comfortable speaking directly with business owners

Ability to think on your feet and respond naturally when a prospect goes off-script

Comfortable handling rejection and making a high volume of calls

Reliable internet connection

Good-quality headset and a quiet, professional calling environment

Dependable, punctual, and able to consistently work agreed calling hours



This is not an entry-level cold calling position. We will provide training on our campaigns, clients, scripts, offers, and systems, but you should already know how to confidently make cold calls.



Hours, Compensation & Opportunity for Full-Time



This position will begin with approximately 3–4 hours of active cold calling per working day.



Calls will be made during North American business hours, so applicants must be comfortable working a schedule that overlaps with US and Canadian time zones. Specific calling hours will be discussed during the interview.



Starting pay is $4 USD per hour.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



If you perform well and consistently demonstrate strong attendance, reliability, call quality, and the ability to generate qualified appointments, there will be an opportunity to increase your hours, increase your compensation, and potentially move into a full-time position with our team.



We want to invest in people who perform. The initial part-time schedule gives us an opportunity to work together and evaluate performance, with the goal of expanding the role for the right person.



How to Apply



A voice recording is required with your application.



Please send us a short voice recording introducing yourself in English. Tell us:



Your name



How long you’ve been cold calling or appointment setting 



What types of businesses or campaigns you’ve called for



Which countries you have experience calling



Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position



Please speak naturally. We’re not looking for a professionally produced recording—we want to hear how you communicate in a normal conversation.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Candidates who pass the initial review will be invited to a live Zoom interview, where we’ll discuss your experience, availability, and the position in more detail.



We’re looking for someone who is confident on the phone, dependable, coachable, and interested in becoming a long-term member of our team.

title: Video Editor
description:
Apply Here: 



About Huzzle:

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.



About the Company:

Our client is a rapidly growing, full-service digital marketing agency specializing in helping blue-collar and trades-based businesses grow through high-impact digital marketing. The agency serves businesses across more than 45 U.S. states and multiple Canadian provinces and territories. Known for its energetic, collaborative culture and rapid growth, the company combines creative experimentation with a strong focus on measurable results. You'll join an ambitious creative team where new ideas are encouraged, performance data informs creative decisions, and editors collaborate closely to continuously raise the standard of content.



Job Summary:

We’re looking for an experienced Video Editor with a strong understanding of short-form social media content, organic virality, audience retention, and performance-driven editing. This isn't simply a role for someone who can make videos look polished. We're looking for an editor who understands why people stop scrolling, why they keep watching, and why they engage. You'll create high-impact content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, paid advertising, websites, and other digital channels. You'll use performance data to continually improve hooks, pacing, music, storytelling, and editing styles. You'll also work closely with two other video editors, sharing creative insights and helping the team push its editing standards forward.



Key Responsibilities:

- Edit engaging short-form video content that captures the authentic, hard-working personality of blue-collar and trades-based businesses.

- Create approximately 5–10 videos per day while maintaining strong creative and brand standards.

- Engineer content for organic reach and engagement using compelling hooks, fast-paced storytelling, trending formats, music, and retention-focused editing techniques.

- Analyze performance metrics to understand why content succeeds or underperforms and apply those insights to future edits.

- Continuously test and refine hooks, pacing, visual treatments, music choices, transitions, and storytelling techniques.

- Produce content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, social advertising, websites, and other digital channels.

- Introduce new editing styles and creative concepts that elevate both client content and the agency's own social media presence.

- Collaborate with two existing editors to exchange ideas, share best practices, and improve the creative team's overall output.

- Help train and mentor fellow editors through feedback, knowledge sharing, and creative workshops.

- Manage post-production workflows across both video and photo projects while meeting fast turnaround times.

- Collaborate with account managers, designers, editors, and other internal stakeholders to develop creative concepts and polished, high-converting visual assets.

- Maintain consistent branding and quality across multiple projects and clients.

- Stay current with social media trends, visual storytelling techniques, editing tools, AI-powered creative technology, and emerging content formats.



Requirements:

- 3–4+ years of professional video and/or photo production experience, ideally within an agency or working directly with businesses.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating successful short-form social media video editing, particularly TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

- Demonstrated understanding of what drives organic reach, virality, watch time, retention, engagement, and click-through rates.

- Strong analytical mindset, you use performance data alongside creative judgment to make better editing decisions.

- Advanced proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Creative Cloud, including Lightroom and relevant video/photo editing applications.

- Experience creating motion graphics and/or animation for short-form videos, social ads, and digital content.

- Familiarity with modern AI media creation and editing tools, such as Higgsfield or similar platforms, and an ability to incorporate AI into creative workflows.

- Ability to produce content quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Comfortable working toward an expected output of 5–10 edited videos per day.

- Strong understanding of social media trends, trending audio, platform-native editing styles, hooks, pacing, and storytelling.

- Genuine interest in blue-collar and trades industries or the curiosity and initiative to quickly learn how these businesses operate and what resonates with their audiences.

- Collaborative mindset with the confidence to share feedback, train teammates, and contribute to the development of other editors.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency with Google Drive and Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within a remote team.



Benefits:

- Fully remote role with the flexibility to work from home.

- High creative ownership with the freedom to experiment with new editing styles, formats, tools, and ideas.

- Performance-driven creative environment where you'll learn from real content data and continually improve your craft.

- Collaborative creative team working alongside two dedicated editors who share ideas, feedback, and creative insights.

- Professional development through continuous learning, mentorship, training, and career development opportunities.

- Exposure to cutting-edge creative technology, including AI-powered media creation and editing workflows.

AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliated entities form a women-founded, integrated real estate firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our headquarters is located in Cupertino, CA, with additional offices in Southern California and Arizona.

The SDR will play a key role in generating new business opportunities by engaging potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting qualified appointments for our agent team. This position is ideal for someone who is organized, persuasive, and thrives in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities:

- Prospect and qualify leads through phone calls, text, email, and CRM outreach.

- Respond promptly to inbound inquiries from online platforms, social media, or marketing campaigns.

- Conduct initial needs assessments to understand buyers’ or sellers’ timelines, goals, and motivation.

- Schedule listing or buyer consultation appointments for senior agents.

- Maintain accurate records of leads and activity in the team CRM (e.g., Salesforce).

- Collaborate closely with the marketing and operations teams to optimize lead conversion.

- Track daily activity metrics — calls, texts, emails, appointments set, and conversion rates.

- Follow up with past clients, warm leads, and sphere contacts to generate repeat and referral business.

- Continuously learn about new construction communities, local market trends, and loan products to better engage prospects.



What We’re Looking For

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable engaging with potential clients over the phone and online.

- Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple lead sources simultaneously.

- Prior experience in real estate sales, inside sales, customer service, or telemarketing preferred.

- Familiarity with real estate CRM systems and marketing automation tools is a plus.

- Goal-oriented with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

- Qualified appointments set per week/month.

- Lead-to-appointment conversion rate.

- Response time to inbound leads.

- Follow-up consistency and pipeline activity.

- Contribution to overall team closings.



Why Join AlphaX?

- Shape Our Strategic Growth: AlphaX is in a pivotal phase of expansion. This is a defining opportunity to partner with our leadership to scale the organization, influence our corporate trajectory, and build a lasting industry legacy.

Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $600 to $750 per month. The actual salary offer will be determined based on the successful candidate's geographic location, relevant experience, and specific skill sets, in accordance with California laws.



AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. **"I can see an opportunity here – I have an idea and this is how I would do it."**



Initiative is extremely important.



## Long-Term Position



This is a **long-term position** for the right person.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted and important member of our business rather than someone looking for occasional freelance work.



Initially, you will work closely with the UK management team while learning about Ocean World Travel, our systems, our customers and our marketing.



Once fully trained, you will be expected to manage your regular marketing responsibilities independently and bring new ideas to the business.



## How to Apply

1. Your CV or details of your relevant marketing experience.

 pages,
 groups or other social media accounts you have personally managed.

 campaigns you have created.

 advertising.

 marketing systems, website platforms and video editing software.

### Short Application Exercise

**Three
 post ideas for Ocean World Travel, one blog topic and one idea for a short video advert.**



You do not need to create graphics or spend a lot of time on this exercise. We are interested in seeing how you think about marketing and what ideas you would bring to our business.

title: Azure & Hybrid Systems Administrator
description:
Azure & Hybrid Systems Administrator    

Reports to: Mgr, Cloud Platform and Data  

FLSA Status: One year contract with potential for full time employment

 

The Company

Meriton is a national investment holding company with a portfolio of six operating companies in the commercial HVAC industry. Founded in 2019, Meriton is the parent holding company to successful commercial HVAC businesses in the nation. All Meriton business offer innovative commercial systems with flexibility of equipment and solutions to best match each application. The Meriton businesses work with industry professionals and end users from the conceptual stage of projects to provide energy efficient, value?added solutions to their complex problems. Our sales professionals offer technical expertise and application experience in the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of building mechanical systems.

 

The overall mission is simple: we want to create value and make a difference every day in our journey to be the best HVAC sales and service organizations in North America. Meriton believes we can succeed in that mission by being the BEST provider for our clients, the BEST partner for manufacturers, the BEST company for our employees, and the BEST investment for our current and future shareholders.

 

The Opportunity

The Azure & Hybrid Systems Administrator serves as a core technical resource responsible for the day-to-day management, reliability, and security of Meriton’s server, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. This role focuses on server lifecycle management, patching and backups, identity and directory services, certificate and DNS management, and modern hybrid operations using Azure Arc and Microsoft 365.  The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge of Microsoft Azure, service management practices, and integration with enterprise applications such as Microsoft Dynamics, ERP, and third-party SaaS solutions.

 

Responsibilities 

· Manage and maintain Windows Server environments across on?premises and cloud-hosted systems.

· Own server lifecycle management, including provisioning, hardening, patching, monitoring, and decommissioning.

· Implement and maintain backup and recovery solutions, regularly validating restore capabilities

· Ensure high availability and reliability through monitoring, alerting, and capacity management.

· Administer Active Directory, including GPOs, domain controllers, trusts, and hybrid identity integration.

· Manage DNS services, name resolution, and related dependencies across hybrid environments.

· Oversee certificate management, including issuance, renewal, monitoring, and expiration prevention.

· Operate and manage hybrid servers and services using Azure Arc for governance, monitoring, patching, and security alignment.

· Support Azure infrastructure components (VMs, storage, networking, identity) as part of a hybrid operating model.

· Contribute to cloud design discussions and modernization initiatives (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS).

· Support endpoint, identity, and collaboration services as they relate to server and directory dependencies.

· Apply and maintain security controls related to identity, access, patching, backups, and configuration management.

· Support compliance, audit, and governance initiatives through documentation and system controls.

· *Create, configure, and manage Azure resources (VMs, storage, networking, identity, and platform services) to meet business and security requirements.

· Maintain and support legacy on-premise servers and associated processes while planning and executing migration to modern cloud services (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS).

· Implement and enforce cloud security standards, including identity and access management, encryption, threat detection, and compliance monitoring.

· Ensure systems are implemented and maintained with monitoring, alerting, and capacity management to support high availability and uptime requirements.

· Provide 24x7 operational support for mission-critical systems, maintaining service continuity and minimizing downtime.

· Manage hybrid and virtualized environments with familiarity in multiple virtualization methods.

· Automate infrastructure provisioning and system management using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Azure Resource Manager templates.

· Apply IT Service Management (ITSM) practices in daily operations.

· Stay current with industry trends, particularly in cloud security, service management, and Azure services.

  

The Required Profile 

· Minimum 5 years of relevant systems/cloud experience; 7 years preferred.

· Proven expertise in Azure cloud administration and security best practices.

· Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) practices (e.g., ITIL).

· Proficiency in scripting and automation (PowerShell, Azure CLI).

· Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC), automation frameworks, and DevOps workflows.

· Skilled in monitoring, alerting, and capacity management to ensure high up time.

· Experience providing 24x7 operational support in enterprise environments.

· Experience maintaining on-premise infrastructure and migrating workloads to cloud (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS).

· CompTIA Security- preferred

 

Required Certification

Candidates must possess at least one of the following Microsoft certifications (all three are preferred):

· Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) 

· Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800) 

· Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-801

 

 

 

Other Skills/Abilities

Strategic Skills

Forward-thinking, transparent in decision-making, and able to set clear expectations across teams.

Teamwork and Collaboration

Committed to open communication and transparency. Build trust across departments by sharing knowledge freely and working cooperatively to solve problems. Actively contributes to a team culture that values respect, accountability, and partnership. 

Behavioral Skills

Resilient problem-solver who thrives under pressure. Approaches challenges with determination, persistence, and the willingness to 'roll up sleeves' to get the work done.  Demonstrates reliability, consistency, and a strong work ethic when driving initiatives to completion.

Reasoning Ability

Capable of analyzing complex, cross-system issues with multiple variables. Adept at prioritizing and executing solutions with precision under governance controls.

Personal and Interpersonal Skills

Clear communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Trusted partner for cross-functional teams, demonstrating integrity, transparency, and accountability. Builds positive relationships while maintaining focus on achieving business objectives.

Environmental Requirements

Ability to work remotely when not required onsite for infrastructure, compliance, or integration initiatives.

Physical Demands

While performing duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to operate a computer and related equipment. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. 

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

 

Meriton is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Shopify & WordPress



Second Screen Digital is seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Web Developer with deep experience building, maintaining, and optimizing websites on both Shopify and WordPress. This is not a page-builder-only position. We need a true developer who can confidently handle complex front-end work, back-end development, custom functionality, third-party integrations, performance optimization, and technical troubleshooting.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical ability with excellent attention to detail and understands how development decisions affect user experience, conversion rates, SEO, accessibility, and overall business performance.



Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain custom Shopify and WordPress websites.

Build responsive, pixel-accurate pages from Figma or other design files.

Create and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify’s APIs.

Develop custom WordPress themes, templates, plugins, and functionality using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional full-stack web development experience.

Advanced experience developing for both Shopify and WordPress.

Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.

Advanced knowledge of Shopify Liquid, theme architecture, metafields, sections, templates, and Shopify APIs.

Experience developing custom Shopify themes and functionality beyond prebuilt themes and applications.

Advanced knowledge of WordPress theme and plugin development.

Experience working with WooCommerce and custom post types.

Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, AJAX, JSON, and third-party integrations.

Experience with Git, version control, staging environments, deployment workflows, and code reviews.

Strong knowledge of responsive development and cross-browser compatibility.

Demonstrated ability to improve site speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall technical performance.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across the full technology stack.

Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to thoroughly test work before deployment.

********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********

2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis, fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.

5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

2.)Omni-Channel Synergy: Proven ability to leverage Shopify D2C ad spend to boost Amazon organic rank, BSR, and halo sales.

Amazon Programs: Hands-on experience collaborating with Amazon SAS Core or dedicated account management support.

******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******

Base Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale managed.

Demonstrate success managing full site backups, staging environments, and seamless site transfers/migrations with minimal downtime.

Track record of optimizing WordPress sites to hit PageSpeed Insights (PSI) scores of 80+ (Mobile & Desktop) and top GTmetrix grades.

Experience deploying security plugins/firewalls (Wordfence, Solid Security, etc.), monitoring brute-force attacks, patching backend vulnerabilities, and cleaning malware.

Experience configuring SMTP plugins and diagnosing transactional
 deliverability issues.

Experience managing caching/CDN tools without breaking third-party tracking scripts, pixels, or site functionality.

Familiarity with setting up, reading, and managing performance alerts or similar auditing tools.

Experience configuring and managing automated uptime monitoring and escalating downtime alerts outside standard hours.

Ability to establish baseline testing protocols before monthly maintenance workflows, including safe plugin updates, vulnerability scanning, and post-update QA testing.

This role is a great fit if you want to grow your technical hard skills.

Enjoy solving complex technical puzzles and critical thinking.

Have a strong problem-solving mindset.

Feel comfortable explaining technical issues clearly.

Are eager to learn, take ownership, and step up to urgent site issues.

Are forward-thinking problem solvers. They see where an issue is heading and plan two steps ahead to prevent downstream issues.



Our culture is very important to us and we look for team members who demonstrate these soft skills:



Proactive, reliable communicator: flags blockers and status before being asked. This team works across time zones with limited real-time overlap, so updates can't wait for someone to come ask.

Documents as they go: time logs, ticket notes, and QA steps live in the system.

Takes ownership through to verification: Uses critical thinking skills to assess if the root cause is confirmed fixed, not just the symptom.

Escalates early when something's outside their depth, rather than quietly guessing on a live client site.

Works well independently and asynchronously, while staying looped in with the maintenance and migration teams during handoffs.

{Ongoing freelance · Social-first creative}



I'm looking for a designer/illustrator to help me build a distinctive visual language around my personal work online, primarily on LinkedIn.



And to be clear: I am NOT looking for someone to make my LinkedIn look MORE polished. I'm a little funny, unhinged, and fun - honest yet authentic in my content. 



I want to make things that make people stop scrolling because my stuff won't really look like LinkedIn content at all and feels like something they have to read. 



My work sits around culture, entertainment, fandom (particularly music/entertainment), human behavior, the internet, work, motherhood and the deeply important question of why people care SO MUCH about things.



I'm looking for someone who can help me turn those observations into visual ideas.



___



THE KIND OF CREATIVE THINKING I'M AFTER



Think less: “social media graphic.”



More:

> editorial illustration

> conceptual art direction

> visual essays

> unexpected data visualization

> diagrams and maps

> mixed media and collage

> hand-drawn annotation

> fake institutional / academic visual language

> beautifully designed cultural artifacts

> the occasional visual that is objectively ridiculous



Some things should be funny. Some should be smart. Some should be beautiful. (Ideally a lot of them are more than one of those things at once.)



The execution should follow the idea, which means I DON'T want every post using the same template, border, type treatment or layout.



One piece might feel like it came from an old science textbook. Another could feel like an editorial spread, research notebook, instruction manual, annotated photograph or something we completely invent.



I want recognizable visual DNA, not recognizable templates.



___



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



This is the important part: I'm not looking for someone who waits for me to hand them finished copy and then makes it pretty.



I'm looking for a creative partner who can help make the idea itself better.



I'll bring observations, stories, research, cultural things I'm noticing, half-formed theories, screenshots and probably a lot of voice notes that start with “okay wait I noticed something weird.” Then I want someone who can hear the idea underneath that and start thinking visually.



Maybe it's an illustration. Maybe it's a diagram. Maybe it's a piece of fake research (these are fun!). Maybe it's a photograph we annotate.



Maybe you have a significantly weirder idea. GOOD!



___



THE VISUAL WORLD



Some references for the level of thinking, not aesthetics to copy:

> &Walsh

> editorial illustration

> visual journalism

> information design

> independent magazines and zines

> internet-native creative

> great advertising art direction

> cultural work that makes you wonder who approved it (complimentary)



I'm especially drawn to work that takes something ordinary, specific or deeply human and gives it an absurd amount of creative attention.



I don't want corporate infographics, generic LinkedIn carousels, motivational graphics, Canva-coded social templates or “personal branding” aesthetics (vomitttt)



And I definitely don't need someone to put my name in the bottom corner of the same graphic 12 times a month.



___

YOU MIGHT BE MY PERSON IF



> You're a designer who illustrates, an illustrator who understands design, or an art director who likes actually making things.

> You have strong conceptual instincts.

> You understand typography and composition.

> You have an internet-native sense of humor without making everything look like a meme.

> You're culturally curious.

> You're proficient in art direction

> You can move between funny and emotionally intelligent.

> You have opinions.

> You can take a half-formed thought and come back with something I didn't think of.

> And occasionally you're willing to say, “your idea is fine but I think this would be better.” (Honestly, that last one is kind of the dream... we need to be able to collaborate to make sh*t the world loves.)



___



THE GOAL

I'm trying to build something recognizable enough that eventually someone sees a piece without immediately seeing my name and thinks: this feels like a thing authentic to her.



Not because every piece looks identical. Because the brain behind them does.



If that sounds like the kind of creative problem you'd have fun solving, send me your portfolio, rates / preferred engagement structure, and 2–3 pieces that best show how you think.



Bonus points for self-initiated work, editorial work, weird experiments, or something you made simply because you couldn't stop thinking about the idea.

title: Short-Form Reel Editor for Luxury Beauty & Wellness Brand
description:
We are looking for a creative short-form video editor to transform existing campaign footage into fresh, elevated Instagram Reels for XVI Global, a beauty and wellness brand centered around intentional self-care, ritual, and Good Karma.



This is not a role for someone who needs every clip and concept selected for them. We need an editor who can review a folder of raw photos and videos, recognize the strongest moments, and develop multiple distinct content ideas from the footage.



PAYMENT



* $5 USD per completed Reel

* One reasonable revision included

* Potential for ongoing work for the right editor

* We will begin with a small paid trial before assigning a larger batch



ABOUT THE PROJECT



We have a folder of professionally produced footage from XVI’s December 2025 campaign shoot. Some of this footage was used to create content for 2026, but there is still a significant amount of strong, unused material.



Our goal is to maximize the content we have already invested in and build a varied library of new Instagram Reels without scheduling another campaign shoot.



You will be expected to review:



* XVI’s 

* XVI’s website: [www.xvi.global](
)

* Our raw campaign footage

* Previously published content for brand direction



You should use our existing content to understand the brand—not simply recreate or slightly modify Reels we have already posted.



ABOUT THE PRODUCT



AURORA is XVI’s hero product. It is a versatile, unisex oil designed for the hair, face, and body.



The content should feel elevated, modern, warm, sensory, intentional, and authentic. It should not feel overly trendy, over-edited, generic, or like a basic template with our footage dropped into it.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



* Review a large folder of raw photo and video footage independently

* Identify the strongest clips and creative opportunities

* Develop multiple original Reel concepts from the footage

* Create strong hooks, text overlays, transitions, pacing, and audio choices

* Produce different types of Reels rather than several versions of the same concept

* Maintain consistency with XVI’s visual identity, messaging, and overall mood

* Keep AURORA positioned as the hero product

* Incorporate themes of ritual, self-care, versatility, and Good Karma when appropriate

* Accept feedback and make one reasonable revision when needed

* Deliver vertical, Instagram-ready videos in 1080 × 1920 format



CONTENT DIRECTIONS



We want a varied content library that may include:



1. Ritual and product experience

   Beautiful, sensory edits showing AURORA being applied or incorporated into an intentional self-care ritual.



2. Male and unisex content — a priority

   We have male-model footage that we want to use more intentionally. AURORA is a unisex product, and the content should show men naturally incorporating it into their routines.



3. Product versatility

   Content showing how AURORA can be used on the hair, face, and body.



4. Educational and benefit-led content

   Reels using hooks and text overlays to explain what AURORA is, how it can be used, and what makes it different.



5. Lifestyle and aspirational content

   Editorial-style videos that communicate the XVI mood and lifestyle without feeling like traditional advertisements.



6. Short aesthetic edits

   Visually strong, scroll-stopping Reels approximately 5–10 seconds long that can be paired with elevated or relevant audio.



7. Brand storytelling

   Content inspired by XVI’s philosophy of intentional self-care, daily rituals, versatility, and Good Karma.



The ideal editor will be able to review the available footage and say, “I see 8–10 different pieces of content here,” without needing us to provide a detailed concept for every Reel.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have experience editing Instagram Reels or short-form vertical videos

* Have worked with beauty, skincare, wellness, fashion, or lifestyle brands

* Understand elevated, premium-looking content

* Can generate concepts and select clips independently

* Know how to create strong hooks and maintain viewer attention

* Understand pacing, music selection, text placement, and visual storytelling

* Can follow an established brand while still bringing fresh creative ideas

* Communicate clearly and meet agreed-upon deadlines

* Are comfortable with the rate of $5 per completed Reel



WHAT WE WILL PROVIDE



* Access to the raw campaign footage

* XVI’s Instagram and website for reference

* Existing brand and product messaging

* Additional product information when needed

* Feedback and approval on concepts and final edits



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “AURORA RITUAL” so we know you read the complete job post.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and description of your editing experience.

2. Links to 3–5 of your strongest short-form videos or Instagram Reels.

3. At least one example created from existing or raw brand footage, if available.

4. Any examples involving beauty, skincare, wellness, lifestyle, or luxury products.

5. The editing software you use.

6. Your typical turnaround time for one Reel.

7. Confirmation that you agree to the rate of $5 per completed Reel.

8. After briefly 
 share one sentence describing how you would characterize the brand’s visual style.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone who understands the creative direction and can see the potential within existing footage.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete one paid trial Reel before receiving a larger batch of content.

-Cold and warm outreach via
, phone, LinkedIn, social media DMs, and any channel that works

-Manage your own pipeline from first touch to signed agreement

-Track activity and deals in ClickUp

-Collaborate async with the team via ClickUp Chat



Compensation

₱25,000/month base, paid weekly.  Plus 15% commission on every dollar of revenue your clients generate for Lyon Global, paid in perpetuity for the life of the account.  That means if you close a client on a ₱10,000/month service, you earn ₱1,500/month from that one client every single month they stay.  Stack enough accounts and this becomes a serious income stream on top of your base.



Who You Are

A self starter who operates like a manager of one.  You don't wait for assignments, SOPs, or supervision.



You have real experience in B2B sales, business development, or consulting sales, not just lead gen.



You're comfortable talking to US business owners on the phone and over video.  Excellent spoken and written English is non negotiable.



You have hands on experience with CRM platforms, ideally all in one business platforms used by agencies or consultants.



You know your way around ClickUp (or can prove you'll pick it up fast).



You understand digital marketing, websites, SEO, paid ads, and how small businesses buy these services.



You are resourceful, persistent, and competitive.  You figure things out without being told how.



Nice to Have

-Background in consulting, digital marketing, or SaaS sales

-Experience selling to US small business owners

-Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach, cold
 strategy, and social selling

-Prior experience working async with a US based remote team



Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention

This isn't a VA gig with a sales title.  This is a real revenue generating role with uncapped earning potential.  The 15% perpetuity commission structure means your income compounds the longer you stay and the more clients you bring in.  If you're good at this, the math gets very attractive very quickly.



Lyon Global is a small, sharp team.  You'll work directly with the founder.  No bureaucracy, no layers, no nonsense.



To Apply

Send a message that tells us:



-Why you're the right fit for this role (not a generic cover letter)

title: Dating assistant
description:
Dating Concierge & Dating App Assistant



Katie’s Dating Concierge is a premium dating concierge service helping successful, busy men take the work out of modern dating. We handle everything from dating profile management and daily swiping to conversations, screening matches, and arranging dates.



We are looking for a confident, outgoing and socially intelligent woman to join our team long-term. ONLY FOR WOMEN.



This is NOT a typical social media or customer service position. You will be communicating with real people on dating apps and with our clients, so you need to be naturally good at conversation, flirting, reading people, and creating genuine chemistry.



What you’ll be doing



Dating App Management



* Manage clients’ dating app profiles and swipe through potential matches.

* Match with women who are a good fit for the client.

* Start and maintain conversations with matches.

* Flirt naturally and confidently while keeping conversations engaging.

* Get to know the women and determine whether they are a good potential match for the client.

* Move conversations toward setting up an actual date.

* Keep track of conversations, matches, and dates.

* Represent the client professionally and in a way that feels natural — the goal is to make the interaction feel authentic, not robotic.



Client Communication



* Communicate directly with our male clients.

* Help onboard new clients and make them feel comfortable using the service.

* Give clients regular updates about their dating activity, matches and progress.

* Answer questions and communicate throughout the dating process.

* Build a comfortable, positive relationship with clients.



Because you will be representing Katie, you should have a warm, confident and slightly flirty communication style with clients as well. Our clients should feel comfortable, appreciated and excited about the service — never embarrassed or awkward about having someone help them with dating.



The ideal candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has perfect or near-perfect English and excellent communication skills.

* Has a clear, natural English accent and is very easy to understand.

* Is confident speaking English — you must be comfortable sending voice messages and speaking with clients.

* Knows how to flirt naturally and keep conversations fun and engaging.

* Is comfortable talking to both men and women.

* Has strong social skills and can read the tone of a conversation.

* Is outgoing, confident and not shy.

* Understands dating, attraction and modern dating culture.

* Ideally has personal experience with dating apps and understands how people actually communicate on them.

* Can keep multiple conversations organized without losing track of details.

* Is reliable, mature and professional.

* Is comfortable representing someone else online and staying consistent with their personality and communication style.

* Has a good sense of humor and knows how to make people feel comfortable.

* Is looking for a serious, long-term position, not a temporary side job.



Important



Personality is extremely important for this role.



We don't want someone who simply knows how to type messages. You need to understand how to create attraction, how to flirt, how to keep someone interested, how to move a conversation forward, and how to make people feel good talking to you.



If you are naturally charming, confident and social, you will probably enjoy this job.



Schedule



* Tuesday – Saturday

* 5 hours per day

* 25 hours per week

* Working according to Toronto time (EST/EDT)

* Fully remote / online



Pay

$7 CAD/hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for someone reliable who wants to grow with the company.



 Requirements



* Laptop/computer

* Reliable, fast Wi-Fi

* VPN

* Quiet environment where you can communicate professionally

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Ability to send voice messages

* Availability Tuesday–Saturday during the agreed working hours

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable using dating apps and communicating online



How to apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous work experience, especially anything related to dating, customer service, sales, social media, communication or online work.

3. Why you think you would be good at this position.

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English. We specifically want to hear your English, pronunciation and communication style, so please do not skip this step.



 If you read the entire job description, include the word “king” in your response message.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Dating App Test



We want to see how you naturally flirt and start conversations. Based on the profiles below, write the first message you would send.



1. Dani, 28



“I can’t date Theo Von so I’m here instead”

Graphic Designer

“I’m stronger than I look”

“I can beat you at being early for everything”



Your opener: _______



2. Miri, 26



“Carrot cake defender”

“Message me if you also love… carrot cake”

University of Toronto

Leo



Your opener: _______



3. Ray, 31



Senior Manager in Consulting

“Blindfold me and tell me 60h work week isn’t healthy 🥱”

“First date wish list: Tennis pls play tennis with me 🥹”

Has a dog



Your opener: _______



4. Follow-up



Her profile: “Drinks on me if you guess where I’m from.”



We sent: “How about drinks on me, and you tell me where you’re from? 😊”



She replied: “Lmao great workaround”



What would you reply? _______



We are looking for messages that are short, natural, playful and flirty — something that would genuinely make the person want to respond.



Please do not use ChatGPT or AI for this test. We want to see how YOU communicate.

title: Creative Director
description:
About Us

We run a high-ticket Done-For-You Airbnb Arbitrage Program that helps entrepreneurs launch and scale profitable Airbnb businesses without the trial and error. We're growing fast and need someone sharp, creative, and hungry to join our team full-time.



The Role

We're looking for a hands-on creative producer who will own the volume and quality of everything that goes in front of our paid ad audience — image ads, video edits, and hook variations, tested at real scale.



This isn't a "make one nice ad a week" role. You'll be producing dozens of new creative variations weekly — new hooks, new edits, new angles on existing winners — so our media buyer always has fresh material to test. We're currently testing ~20 creatives a month and need to be testing hundreds.



I own the strategy — the angles, the offers, what themes to explore. You own turning that into a constant stream of scroll-stopping creative, fast. If you've run your own content or social agency before, this is that same production muscle, just pointed at performance instead of brand.



This is a long-term seat. The person who does this well ends up building and running the creative team under them.



Responsibilities

Produce a high volume of image and video ad creative weekly — hook swaps, new edits, resizing for placements, testing variations of proven winners.



Edit raw footage/photos into scroll-stopping short-form video ads (CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent).



Design static image ads in Canva or equivalent, on-brand and conversion-focused.



Turn rough ideas, Looms, and competitor references into finished creative fast — no hand-holding required.



Maintain a swipe file of competitor and top-performing ads from the Meta Ad Library for inspiration.



Keep the creative library organized and tagged so winners and their variants are easy to find and iterate on.



Work closely with our media buyer — take their read on what's working/dying and turn it into the next batch of creative to test.



Proactively pitch new angles and formats, not just execute what's asked.



Requirements

Real, demonstrable design and video editing chops — a portfolio of ads or social content you've actually made, not just directed.



Experience running or working inside a social media / content agency is a big plus — we specifically want people who know how to produce at volume, not just produce one polished piece at a time.



Comfortable with Canva, CapCut, Premiere (or equivalent) and moving fast between them.



Understands what makes a paid social ad stop the scroll — hook-first thinking, not brand-deck thinking.



Extremely self-sufficient with a "figure it out" attitude. I don't have time to unblock you daily.



Obsessive attention to detail — off-brand or sloppy creative going live is unacceptable.



Full-time availability, 40 hours per week, 10 AM – 6 PM ET.



Compensation

$4,000/month to start.



Performance bonus up to $1,000/month tied to creative testing volume and quality, to be discussed after 90 days in the role.



Long-term role with real growth as we scale and build out a creative team.

Fill out this link →

title: Life Insurance Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking experienced, highly motivated Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistants to support a growing life insurance company.



This is a performance-driven sales role focused primarily on outbound calling to cold leads, creating interest, having quality conversations, and booking qualified appointments for the sales team.



We are looking for candidates who are exceptional on the phone, confident speaking with cold prospects, comfortable overcoming objections, and motivated by measurable results.



Candidates should have at least 2 years of successful outbound calling, appointment setting, or phone-based sales experience. Life insurance experience is a plus but is not required.



Key Responsibilities:

* Make a high volume of outbound calls to cold leads

* Engage prospects quickly and professionally

* Build rapport and create interest over the phone

* Clearly communicate the reason for the call and value proposition

* Ask effective questions to identify interest and potential needs

* Handle common objections confidently

* Follow established scripts while communicating naturally

* Book qualified appointments for the sales team

* Follow up consistently with leads who do not initially schedule

* Maintain accurate lead notes, dispositions, and follow-up information

* Manage leads and activities within the CRM

* Consistently work toward established calling, appointment, and performance goals



Required Qualifications:

* 2+ years of demonstrated success in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone-based sales

* Excellent spoken English

* Exceptional phone presence and communication skills

* Proven ability to successfully book appointments from cold leads

* Strong sales and persuasion skills

* Comfortable handling objections and rejection

* Confident, energetic, and engaging on the phone

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Comfortable using a CRM and managing a sales pipeline

* Self-motivated and able to perform without constant supervision

* Results-oriented and comfortable being measured against clear performance expectations



Required

* Previous life insurance or insurance industry experience

* Experience calling U.S.-based consumers

* Experience working in a commission or performance-incentive environment

* Familiarity with insurance lead generation and appointment-setting processes



Performance Expectations

This is not simply a calling or administrative position. Success will be measured by results.



The right candidate will be expected to consistently:

* Maintain strong outbound calling activity

* Connect and engage effectively with cold prospects

* Generate qualified interest

* Book appointments

* Follow up persistently

* Meet or exceed established performance targets



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sales, is comfortable discussing life insurance with prospects, likes competing against goals, and takes personal ownership of their performance.



Compensation & Incentives:

In addition to hourly compensation, this role will include a commission and/or performance incentive component designed to reward strong results. High performers will have the opportunity to increase their earnings based on their success.



What Success Looks Like:

The right VA will be someone the sales team can confidently give life insurance leads to, knowing they will consistently pick up the phone, create meaningful conversations, explain the value of life insurance, overcome objections, follow up relentlessly, and put qualified appointments on the calendar.



We are looking for proven life insurance appointment setters who understand the industry, know how to work cold leads, want to perform and produce, and are motivated to be rewarded for their results.

title: B2B Cold Caller, Prospecting, Lead / Sales Generation, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.

title: Customer Experience Lead - US Swim School (Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time)
description:

About us. We are a premier swim school in Boston. We teach kids and families to swim across several locations in the Greater Boston area. We are warm, family-friendly, and safety-first, and we want someone who sounds like part of the family on every call and message.



The role. You are our enrollment engine and the voice of the school to families. Must-haves

- Clear, natural-sounding English, spoken and written. You will be on the phone and texting with US parents every day, so friendly, easy-to-understand communication is essential.

- Real customer experience. You have worked directly with customers before, ideally US or Western, and are comfortable talking with them, answering questions, and handling concerns with warmth.

- Comfortable on the phone and asking for the sale, in a friendly, consultative way that is never pushy.

- Organized and reliable, with strong follow-through. Nothing slips.

- A proper work-from-home setup: a reliable computer, fast internet, and a quiet space with a good headset for calls.



What you will do

- Respond to new leads within the hour, understand what the family needs, recommend the right class, answer objections, and complete the enrollment. Follow up consistently so no lead goes cold.

- Handle family communication across the journey: welcomes and onboarding, schedule and instructor changes, cancellations and makeups, progress check-ins, and re-enrollment outreach.

- Keep our CRM clean and current, and never leave a lead without a next step.

- Start each day by reviewing the previous day's activity and handling move-ups, makeups, and requests; send a short end-of-day report; and hand off open items to the Operations assistant.

- Report a few key numbers each week and join a short weekly team meeting.



What success looks like

- Fast first contact (within 1 hour)

- Strong conversion (target 45%+ of leads enroll)

- Growing net enrollments

- A clean pipeline with no leads left hanging



Tools you will use. HubSpot, Voxie, RingCentral, JackRabbit, Pumble, Google Workspace. Experience with any is a plus; we will train the rest.



Nice to have. US or Western customer experience; phone sales or account management; a background in education, childcare, or another family-focused business.



How to apply. Please send a short message that includes:

- Start your message with the word MARLIN (so we know you read this).

- One or two sentences on your experience talking with customers, especially by phone.

- Confirm you can work the night-shift hours above, and briefly describe your internet speed and call setup.

- One example of a time you helped an unsure customer say yes.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a short 30-60 second voice or video introduction before we schedule an interview.

title: Instagram Content Creator & Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
The Keystone Men Community

I’m building The Keystone Men Community, a community for men who are ready to heal, grow, release old patterns, and become more fully themselves.



Our work centers around breathwork, embodiment, nervous-system awareness, emotional healing, and personal growth—helping men reconnect with themselves and show up with more presence, honesty, strength, and connection.

I’m looking for a part-time Content Creator & Digital Marketing Assistant who is excited about the mission and wants to help us grow.



The Role

My primary need is Instagram content creation.

I’ll provide most of the voice, ideas, teachings, recordings, and words. I need someone who can take that raw material and turn it into engaging, consistent content.



You’ll help with:

- Editing Reels and short-form video

- Creating hooks, subtitles, carousels, and graphics

- Repurposing longer recordings into multiple pieces of content

- Polishing captions while keeping my voice

- Scheduling and organizing content

- Helping track what resonates and improve what we're creating



As we grow, I’d also love your help with the digital marketing side of the business, including:

- Building landing pages and opt-in pages in Simplero

- Setting up simple funnels and automations

- Formatting and scheduling emails

- Creating lead magnets and signup flows

- Helping connect our Instagram content to offers, breathwork experiences, and the community



You do not need to already be an expert in Simplero. If you’re comfortable with technology, willing to learn, and have experience with similar marketing platforms, that works too.





Who I’m Looking For

I’d especially love to work with someone who feels personally connected to this mission.

Maybe you’re already interested in breathwork, men’s work, embodiment, emotional healing, relationships, masculinity, or personal growth.



You don't need to have it all figured out. This community is for men who are actively healing, growing, releasing, learning, and becoming.

Ideally, you’ll experience some of the breathwork and participate in the community yourself.

I want someone who wants to be part of what we're building—not just someone making posts from the outside.

I’m looking for someone creative, reliable, detail-oriented, comfortable with technology, and able to take an idea and help turn it into something finished.





How to Apply

Send me a brief introduction, examples of content you’ve created, and a few sentences about why The Keystone Men Community interests you.

If you have experience with Simplero, funnels, landing pages, email marketing, Canva, or similar tools, tell me about that too.

At the very end of your application, tell me your favorite breathing pattern or breathwork practice and why you like it.

If you don't have one yet, find one that interests you and tell me why you chose it.

title: SEO & SEM Specialist
description:
SEO & SEM Specialist



Location: Remote, working with a Singapore-based team  



Employment type: Full-time, 44 hours per week / 176 hours per month  



Working hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 9:00pm Singapore time  



Reporting to: Senior SEO Manager and CEO  



Experience required: 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience. Singapore education, tuition or local-service experience is strongly preferred.



About Achievers Dream

- Achievers Dream is a Singapore Chemistry and Science tuition specialist. The centre supports Primary Science students and students taking O-Level, IP and JC H1/H2 Chemistry, with centres at Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan. Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

title: Supply Chain Manager – E-commerce | EU-Based Brand
description:
We are a fast-growing EU-based e-commerce brand looking for a Supply Chain Manager who can take ownership of our supply chain from supplier to warehouse.



You will work directly with the founders and our suppliers, logistics partners and warehouses. This is not just an administrative purchasing role. We are looking for someone who can plan ahead, work with data, negotiate with suppliers and continuously improve the way our supply chain operates.



A key part of the role will also be helping us build and improve our own internal supply chain tools and dashboards, using automation, AI and no-code tools where useful.



What you’ll be responsible for:



- Manage day-to-day communication with suppliers

- Create and manage purchase orders and production planning

- Monitor production timelines and proactively prevent delays

- Coordinate international shipments, freight forwarders and warehouses

- Manage inventory across our e-commerce channels and warehouses

- Build accurate inventory forecasts based on sales, lead times and seasonality

- Determine when and how much stock needs to be reordered

 - Prevent both stock-outs and unnecessary overstock

- Negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times and payment terms with suppliers

- Improve supplier agreements and working capital where possible

- Maintain a clear overview of upcoming payments and purchasing commitments

- Build and improve internal supply chain dashboards, systems and automations

- Create better processes for forecasting, purchasing, logistics and inventory management

- Identify risks early and come up with solutions before they become problems



Who we’re looking for



You are structured, analytical and proactive. You don’t wait until inventory runs out or a shipment is delayed—you spot potential issues beforehand and take action.



Ideally, you have experience working in e-commerce, consumer products or an international supply chain environment.



We’d love to work with someone who:



Has experience with inventory planning, purchasing or supply chain management

Is comfortable communicating and negotiating with international suppliers

Has strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

Understands forecasting, lead times, MOQs and inventory management

Is interested in AI, automation and building smarter internal tools

Communicates clearly in English

Is highly organized and detail-oriented

Takes ownership and follows tasks through until they are completed

Can work independently while keeping the team updated

Enjoys improving processes instead of simply following existing ones



Experience with Shopify, Amazon, 3PLs, freight forwarding, ERP/inventory systems, Make, Zapier or other automation/no-code tools is a plus.



What we offer



You’ll join a small and ambitious European e-commerce team where you can have a direct impact on the business. You won’t be one person in a huge supply chain department—you’ll have the opportunity to build the systems, processes and tools with us as we grow.



This role can grow into broader responsibility for our complete supply chain and operations.



Hours: 32–40 hours per week

Location: Remote

Working hours: Some overlap with European/CET business hours is required.



When applying, please tell us briefly about your previous supply chain experience and give us an example of a situation where you improved inventory planning, supplier terms or another supply chain process.



Bonus: Start your application with the word “FORECAST” so we know you’ve read the full job post.
