title: Inventory Assistant
description:
Inventory Assistant

Remote | Full-time



HOW TO APPLY

- Applications are accepted only through our official application form: 



Scriveiner is looking for a detail-driven Inventory Assistant to help keep our global stock operations accurate, organised, and moving.



This is a hands-on operations role for someone who has already worked with inventory records, order fulfilment, stock reconciliations, and ideally Amazon Seller Central/FBA. You will work closely with our Inventory Manager and third-party logistics partners to make sure stock records are reliable, Amazon shipments are handled correctly, and discrepancies are caught before they affect customers or sales.



If you enjoy investigating mismatches, keeping data clean, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, you will enjoy this role.



BEFORE YOU APPLY



This role is best suited to you if you have:



- Hands-on experience in inventory, warehousing, fulfilment, e-commerce operations, or retail operations

- Experience using Amazon Seller Central, including FBA shipment creation or management

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for tracking, reconciliations, and reporting

- Experience working with stock records, order processes, and discrepancies

- A highly organised, proactive working style—you flag issues early and follow them through



**Please do not apply if your experience is limited to general administration, customer service, or retail sales without responsibility for stock, fulfilment, or inventory records.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Keep inventory records accurate

- Maintain and reconcile inventory data across internal stock records, dashboards, and e-commerce platforms

- Carry out cycle counts, spot checks, and stocktakes

- Investigate stock discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage, and help resolve them promptly

- Monitor stock levels and flag low-stock or overstock risks to the Inventory Manager

- Update stock availability on wholesale platforms, including Faire and Turis

- Support fulfilment and 3PL operations

- Import and process orders in our 3PL partners’ systems

- Check for unfulfilled, incomplete, or problematic orders and follow these through

- Coordinate retail and wholesale orders for accurate, timely dispatch

- Process incoming supplier and freight shipments, checking quantities, quality, and delivery discrepancies

- Manage Amazon FBA operations

- Create, verify, track, and update Amazon FBA shipments in Seller Central

- Maintain accurate shipment-status records

- Support FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units

- Keep dispute and compliance records organised and up to date

- Provide reliable reporting

- Prepare the weekly OD report and maintain supporting dispute records

- Produce inventory and variance reports using Excel/Google Sheets and Power BI

- Support stock planning, forecasting, and buying decisions with accurate data

- Take on other operational tasks that support the Inventory and Operations teams



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Previous experience in inventory, warehousing, fulfilment, retail operations, or e-commerce operations

- Practical Amazon Seller Central and FBA experience

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Confidence investigating data discrepancies and following issues through to resolution

- Clear, proactive communication with internal teams, suppliers, and logistics partners



Desirable

- Experience with 3PL fulfilment systems or workflows

- Experience with Faire, Turis, a WMS, ERP, Power BI, or similar reporting tools

- Experience with FBA reimbursements, Amazon compliance disputes, or inbound shipment management

- Knowledge of FIFO and inventory-control best practices

- Experience using AI tools to improve reporting or operational workflows



ABOUT SCRIVEINER

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, we now serve millions of customers worldwide through major online marketplaces and more than 1,000 retail stores globally.



We are the flagship brand of Infinity Brands: a founder-led, high-growth business building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are practical, ambitious, and hands-on—and we care deeply about the quality of both our products and customer experience.

title: Shopify + Printify E-Commerce Specialist
description:
Part-Time / Ongoing Contract Position Potential to Grow Into Full-Time

We are looking for a detail-oriented, creative, and highly organized Shopify + Printify E-Commerce Specialist to join our team.

We already have the basic Shopify and Printify structure in place. We are not looking for someone to build an e-commerce system from scratch. We need someone who can take our existing structure and efficiently create and maintain beautiful, organized merchandise collections for our clients.

What You'll Be Doing

You will be responsible for building and maintaining client merchandise collections within our existing Shopify and Printify setup.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Creating new client collections in Shopify

* Creating and managing products through Printify

* Uploading client logos and artwork that have already been created

* Applying logos/designs appropriately to merchandise

* Creating clean, attractive product mockups

* Making sure logos are sized, positioned, and displayed correctly

* Selecting appropriate product variants, sizes, and options

* Writing or formatting basic product titles and descriptions

* Organizing products into the correct client collections

* Making each collection visually appealing and easy to shop

* Checking products for consistency before publishing

* Maintaining and updating existing collections

* Adding new products when requested

* Removing or replacing discontinued products

* Troubleshooting basic Shopify/Printify product issues

* Following our established processes, brand standards, and checklists

* Keeping track of requests and completing projects on time

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is both technical and visually detail-oriented.

You should be comfortable working independently inside Shopify and Printify without needing step-by-step instruction for every task.

Experience with Shopify and Printify is strongly preferred.

The right person:

* Has excellent attention to detail

* Has a good eye for layout, presentation, and merchandising

title: CX Operations Associate (remote)
description:
Company:

Coterie Baby, Inc. is a modern baby care brand offering high-quality, eco-friendly diapers and wipes for a premium diapering experience. We pride ourselves on a customer-centric approach, ensuring parents have a beloved brand they can trust.



Job Overview:

Coterie is seeking an Operations Associate who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning complex operational workflows from start to finish. In this role, you will help keep orders, subscriptions, fraud reviews, chargebacks, and post-purchase exceptions moving smoothly across our systems. This role is not only about completing assigned tasks, but also about proactively noticing recurring issues, identifying opportunities to improve how work gets done, and helping make our CX operations stronger over time. You will work across tools, queues, and cross-functional teams to investigate issues, resolve blockers, spot patterns, review trends, complete audits, identify SOP gaps, and protect the customer experience behind the scenes. If you enjoy solving operational problems, managing high-impact details, and taking ownership in a fast-moving environment, we want you on our team.



Key Responsibilities:



- Support Order Flow: Check, clear, and resolve quarantined orders across our warehouse systems to keep orders moving. This may include pushing orders through Netsuite, making order corrections and communicating with customers when needed.



- Own Fraud Operations: Review and action fraud alerts, approve or cancel high-risk orders, and assist in chargeback resolutions. Conduct regular fraud reviews to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for prevention.



- Manage Subscription Alerts: Investigate and resolve subscription alerts to ensure active accounts align with current product offerings, approved product combinations, billing rules, and subscription frequencies.



- Post-Purchase Order Management: Resolve and replace orders flagged by P44, including incorrect address, damaged, available for pick-up, refused/RTS, idle shipments, and orders missing initial scan for 3+ days. Notify customers directly when replacements are issued.



- Support Technical Issue Resolution: Submit technical issues through Jira and partner with the appropriate cross-functional teams to ensure they are investigated and resolved.



- Support Moderation & Ad Hoc Tasks: Assist with TikTok ad moderation and operational tasks as needed, including manually creating shipping labels, supporting data projects, executing cross-functional discount requests, and providing occasional customer-facing or inbox support.



Who You Are:

- Analytical Problem Solver: You can investigate complex operational issues, identify patterns, and get to the root cause quickly. You are comfortable reviewing data, spotting discrepancies, and making clear decisions based on evidence.



- Detail-Oriented Operator: You are highly accurate in repetitive, high-impact workflows where small misses can create larger downstream issues. You are comfortable working across multiple systems, tools, and queues without losing track of the details.



- Clear Communicator: You communicate clearly, concisely, and professionally across internal teams and, when needed, directly with customers. You can explain issues, next steps, and resolutions in a way that keeps the experience smooth and considerate.



- Ownership-Driven Executor: You take full ownership of your work from investigation through resolution. You are proactive, independent, and comfortable managing changing priorities while making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience: 1+ year in operations, fraud, billing, technical support, case management, or complex issue resolution. Experience in e-commerce, retail, subscription, or order management is preferred.



- Ownership: You have real experience owning issues from investigation through resolution, including follow-up, documentation, and process improvements when needed.



- Technical Skills: Experience with tools like Shopify, NetSuite, Jira, Kustomer/Zendesk, warehouse systems, or fraud/chargeback platforms is a plus.



- Work Setup: Reliable internet (high-speed connection) and computer required



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Competitive Salary: Starting at $898 USD per month (approximately 56,423 PHP) base pay (including stipend).

• 13th Month Pay: We provide a 13th month bonus pay every year, aligned with Filipino employment traditions.

• Paid Training & Growth: Paid training is provided to get you up to speed on our products and tools. We invest in continuous skill development – expect mentorship and access to resources to help you grow with us.

• Monthly Internet Stipend: We also provide a monthly internet allowance ($50USD) to ensure you have a stable connection for work.

• Team Culture & Perks: Join a supportive, friendly team. We have weekly video meetings to stay connected and fun occasional team-building activities. You’ll be part of a company that values its people – 100% of employees say Coterie is a great place to work!
. Plus, we celebrate your milestones (like birthdays and other special occasions) with small gifts or bonuses as a token of appreciation.



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIREMENTS)

Apply by sending us your resume and a short video introduction created JUST FOR COTERIE!



In your video:

• Tell us why you’re excited to join our team.

• Share an example of something you owned and improved 



We value thoughtful, PERSONALIZED SUBMISSIONS that give us a real sense of you, your style, your personality, and how you connect with customers. At Coterie, we work in a high-volume environment while still delivering white-glove service, so we’re looking for people who can thrive in both. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.

FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: Appointment Setter for a Tampa Custom Suiting Brand (US Hours, Long Term)
description:
Coat of Colour is a Tampa, Florida custom apparel company. We build made-to-measure graduation blazer programs for schools and universities, staff uniform programs for hotels and organizations, and custom suiting for individual clients. We are a certified minority-owned business and have delivered 300+ garments for a single multi-year university program.



What the job actually is:

You spend your mornings on the phone with schools, universities, hotels, and churches, finding the one person who d
 what their people wear. Sometimes that is a dean. Sometimes it is a hotel GM or an HR manager. You get past the front desk, find out whether there is a real need, and put a call on my calendar.



You are not selling suits. I close. Your job is to open the door and make sure the conversations that reach me are worth having.



A good week looks like this:

You are making somewhere between 60 and 100 dials a shift from a list we give you, and adding to that list as you go, tracking down the right name, title, direct line, and
. You book appointments with enough notes that I know before I dial who they are, what they need, how many people it covers, when they need it, and whether this person can actually sign. You follow up so people show up. You log everything. At the end of the day you send a short note: how many dials, how many conversations, how many appointments, and what objections you kept running into.



What you need to bring:

Spoken English that sounds easy and clear on the phone, because you will be talking to deans and hotel managers, not filling out forms. (Preferred) At least a year of B2B cold calling or appointment setting for US clients. Comfort with being told no and calling the next number anyway.



On the technical side: reliable internet, a quiet room, and availability during US Eastern business hours. You should be comfortable in Google Workspace, a CRM, and spreadsheets.



Helpful but not required: apparel, uniform, hospitality, or education sales experience,
 copywriting, or any familiarity with supplier diversity or government procurement.



Hours and pay:

We start at 20 hours a week, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern, and move to full time once the calls are producing. Base pay, plus $25 for every qualified appointment that actually happens, plus a bonus when a contract closes from one of your appointments. Paid every two weeks. The first 30 days are a paid trial for both of us, and I am looking for someone who stays for years, not months.



How to apply:

Record 60 to 90 seconds of audio. Introduce yourself, then read this like the front desk at a college just picked up: "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Coat of Colour in Tampa. We run custom graduation blazer programs for colleges. Who handles that for your graduating class?"



Then tell me, in your own words: where you were calling most recently, what your usual dials per day and appointments per week looked like, and what you say when someone tells you to just send an
.



Skip the template applications. I read every voice recording, and that is what I am d
 on.

title: Short-Form Podcast Video Editor | Full-Time Video Editor
description:
We are hiring a full-time video editor to join our team and become the primary editor for our growing veterans/military content brand.



This is not a one-time freelance project.



We already have a large backlog of podcast footage ready to edit, and we are building a much bigger organic content operation around:



Instagram Reels

TikTok

YouTube Shorts

Podcast clips

Talking-head educational content

Eventually long-form YouTube



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term editing position and can grow with us.



If you're looking to squeeze another small client into an already packed freelance schedule, this probably isn't the right fit.



If you're looking for a full-time editing role where you can become deeply familiar with one brand, improve the content over time, and take real ownership of the editing process, keep reading.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



The Content



We create educational content in the U.S. veterans/military space.



Our current priority is a two-camera podcast project that should produce approximately 40+ short-form videos.



Most finished videos will be around:



60–120 seconds



Some answers may be turned into multiple clips.



After this backlog is complete, there will be continued short-form content, additional podcast recordings, talking-head content, and eventually long-form YouTube.



We are not hiring for 40 videos.



We are hiring an editor we want to keep.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What You'll Be Editing



The current podcast setup has:



One interviewer asking the questions

One primary speaker answering

Two separate camera angles

Educational / conversational content

Longer answers that need to be turned into strong short-form clips



The content has already been organized to make the editing process easier.



The raw footage includes large 4K files, so you need a computer, internet connection, and storage setup capable of handling them comfortably.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Editing Style



We want the videos to feel:



Clean. Modern. Professional. Engaging.



We are NOT looking for videos with random graphics, animations, and effects every two seconds.



The audience is veterans and military members, so the content needs to feel credible and easy to watch.



You should be comfortable with:



Clean captions/subtitles

Removing unnecessary pauses and dead space

Punch-ins and zooms

Speaker changes

Full-screen speaker shots

Stacked or split-screen podcast layouts

Relevant B-roll and images

Simple graphics when useful

Visual hooks

Sound effects when appropriate

Pattern interrupts

Strong pacing

Making educational talking-head content hold attention



The biggest skill we care about is editing judgment.



You need to know when something improves the video and when adding more simply makes it worse.



We will provide reference videos so you understand the direction.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Podcast / Talking-Head Experience Strongly Preferred



We strongly prefer editors who have previously worked with:



Podcasts

Interviews

Personal brands

Coaches/consultants

Educational creators

Talking-head content

Business content



We specifically want to see actual videos you have edited.



Do not send us only a flashy 30-second showreel.



We want to watch the real content.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This Is a Full-Time Role



We are looking for someone available approximately:



- 40 hours per week



We want this to become your primary editing position.



We understand that some editors may still have a small side client or occasional project.



That is fine.



What we do NOT want is someone who already has:



- A full-time job

- Several demanding clients

- An agency workload

- 100+ other videos to edit every month



...and is trying to fit us into whatever time is left over.



We have already dealt with delays and need someone who has the actual capacity to prioritize this role.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What We're Looking For



The right person is:



- A strong video editor

- Reliable

- Fast without sacrificing quality

- Good at following references

- Comfortable receiving feedback

- Organized

- Communicative

- Able to meet deadlines

- Interested in improving over time

- Able to work independently once the style is established

- Interested in being part of something long-term



We do not expect perfection on day one.



We do expect you to communicate, improve quickly, and do what you say you're going to do.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Technical Requirements



You should have:



A computer capable of editing large 4K files

Reliable high-speed internet

Enough storage for large video projects

Experience working with multi-camera footage

Strong spoken-English comprehension

Strong captioning accuracy

A professional editing workflow



Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, CapCut Desktop, or another professional editing setup can work.



The finished product matters more than the software.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Immediate Start



We are already behind schedule and need someone who can start ASAP.



The first step will be creating approximately 2 initial videos so we can finalize the editing style together.



Then we will move into the larger backlog.



For the first 5–10 videos, we may test a few different layouts and editing approaches.



Once we determine what works best, we want to build a repeatable system so production becomes faster and easier.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



How to Apply - Loom recording is preferred



Start your application with:



MILITARY PODCAST



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we will assume you did not read the post.



Then answer these questions:



(1) Send 2–3 direct links to podcast, interview, talking-head, or educational videos you personally edited. Please do not send only a showreel.

(2) What is your current workload? Tell us if you have another full-time job, how many clients you currently work with, and roughly how many videos you edit per week.

(3)  If hired full-time, would this become your primary job? If you plan to keep other work, explain what you would continue doing

(4) In a 40-hour week, how many high-quality 60–120 second podcast clips could you realistically complete?

(5) If we sent you the first footage today, what exact day could you return the first rough draft?

(6) Can your setup comfortably handle multi-camera 4K footage with individual files around 10–20GB? Tell us what editing software you use.

(7) What monthly salary are you looking for for a full-time role?



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Please Do Not Apply If

- You cannot start soon

- You already have a full-time job you plan to keep

- Your current client workload is already heavy

- You cannot comfortably handle large 4K files

- You cannot show relevant work

- You plan to outsource the editing without telling us

-  You regularly miss deadlines

- You disappear when projects get difficult

- You only have gaming, meme, wedding, or montage editing examples

 -You are sending a generic application without reading the post



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What This Can Become



We're still early in building this content operation.



That means the person who joins now has the opportunity to become the editor who understands the brand better than anyone else.



Over time, the role may expand beyond simply receiving footage and cutting clips.



There may be opportunities to help with:



Editing systems

Content organization

Long-form YouTube

Thumbnail/creative collaboration

Testing new short-form styles

Identifying strong moments from longer recordings

Improving retention

Helping us build a repeatable content machine



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, not just someone who wants another editing gig.



If you're talented, dependable, hungry to improve, and looking for a long-term full-time editing role, we want to see your work.

title: E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist
description:
Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce Brand



We are an Australian fashion/e-commerce business looking for an experienced E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist to join us full-time remotely.



This is NOT a social media manager role.



We are not looking for someone to simply create Instagram posts, write captions or maintain a content calendar.



We are looking for someone who understands the technical backend of an e-commerce business and can take ownership of our digital ecosystem — Shopify, Google, Meta, tracking, analytics, SEO, advertising infrastructure and performance.



Initially, this will be a hands-on audit, repair and optimisation project. Once the foundations are working correctly, the role will evolve into ongoing digital growth and campaign management.



THE INITIAL PROJECT



Your first responsibility will be to thoroughly review our existing digital setup.



We want you to find what is working, what isn't working, what has been configured incorrectly, what is missing and what can be improved.



This includes reviewing and working directly with:



Shopify — store configuration, apps, integrations, technical issues, site structure and performance



Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — tracking, events, conversions, attribution and reporting



Google Tag Manager



Google Search Console



Google Merchant Center and product feeds



Google Ads — account structure, conversion tracking, audiences and campaign infrastructure



Meta Business Suite / Business Manager



Meta Ads Manager



Meta Pixel and Conversion API


 and Instagram account integration



Shopify/Meta/Instagram catalogue and commerce integrations



Domain verification and associated Meta assets



SEO — technical SEO, on-page SEO, indexing, metadata, site structure, schema and organic search opportunities



Website speed and technical performance



Conversion tracking and attribution



E-commerce analytics and reporting



We don't just want reports telling us there is a problem.  We want someone capable of actually fixing the problems.



THEN WE WANT TO GROW



Once the digital foundations are correct, your role will progressively move into performance and growth.



You should be comfortable looking at real business data and understanding what it means.



That includes metrics such as:



Traffic | Conversion Rate | ROAS | CAC | CPA | CTR | CPC | AOV | Revenue | Customer Acquisition | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance | Organic Traffic | Search Rankings



More importantly, you need to understand what levers to pull when those numbers aren't where they should be.



We want someone who can investigate why performance is changing and then take action.



That could mean improving SEO, restructuring a campaign, correcting tracking, improving a landing page, changing audiences, fixing a product feed, improving site structure or identifying another problem within the customer journey.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have genuine hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify / GA4 / Google Tag Manager / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads Manager / Meta Pixel / Conversion API / Instagram integration / Technical SEO / E-commerce Analytics / CRO



You don't necessarily need to be the world's leading expert in every platform.



But you do need to understand how these systems connect and work together.



We are looking for someone who:



Is technically strong and enjoys solving problems



Can work independently and take ownership



Understands e-commerce and digital performance



Is highly analytical



Can interpret data rather than simply produce reports



Can identify problems and recommend solutions



Is comfortable implementing fixes personally



Can clearly explain what they have found and why it matters



Documents changes and maintains an organised digital environment



Is interested in building something over time rather than completing isolated freelance tasks



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not primarily:



Social media management, Graphic design, Influencer management, Posting content to Instagram, Writing captions, General virtual assistant work



Those functions may interact with your role, but they are not why we are hiring you.



We are hiring you to understand, manage and improve the technical and performance infrastructure behind our e-commerce business.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are initially looking at approximately a 6-month full-time engagement, with the potential for this to become a permanent long-term position.



The first stage will focus heavily on auditing, repairing and improving our existing infrastructure.



From there, we want the successful person to become increasingly involved in SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, website optimisation, analytics, conversion optimisation and overall e-commerce growth.



You will work directly with the business owners and will have significant ownership over the project.



We care much more about capability, initiative and results than qualifications.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application by telling us about yourself and your experience. 



Then answer the following:



1. Tell us about a Shopify store where you personally worked on the technical/performance setup. What did you actually do?



2. What would you check first if Shopify showed 100 orders but GA4 only reported 65 purchases?



3. What are the first things you would audit inside Meta Business Manager for an established e-commerce brand?



4. Explain the difference between Meta Pixel tracking and Conversion API in simple terms.



5. What would you investigate if organic Google traffic had been declining for six months?



6. What are the five most important e-commerce metrics you would want to see every week, and why?



7. Which of these platforms would you consider yourself genuinely advanced in?



Shopify / GA4 / GTM / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads / Technical SEO / CRO



8. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



9. What country and city are you based in?



10. Please provide examples of e-commerce businesses you have previously worked with and explain your personal involvement.



We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of the digital engine of the business, understand the numbers, fix the problems and help us grow it.

title: Insurance Billing Team Lead
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Insurance Billing Team Lead to oversee our insurance billing operations and support a team responsible for managing the complete insurance claim lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of insurance billing processes, excellent follow-up skills, and the ability to lead, train, and support a team while ensuring claims are accurately managed from initial submission through final processing and payment resolution.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with insurance claim follow-up, a strong background in dental or healthcare billing, and the ability to oversee daily workflows, provide guidance to team members, and ensure department goals are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee and support the insurance billing team, including monitoring workflows, assigning priorities, and ensuring timely completion of claim follow-up activities.

Provide leadership, guidance, and coaching to team members to improve accuracy, efficiency, and overall performance.

Manage the full insurance claim lifecycle, from initial claim submission through final adjudication and payment resolution.

Follow up with insurance companies regarding outstanding, delayed, denied, or pending claims.

Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and insurance responses to determine appropriate next steps.

Identify claim discrepancies, missing information, coding issues, and documentation requirements.

Work directly with insurance carriers to obtain claim status updates and resolve payment delays.

Monitor claim aging reports and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding claims.

Review team documentation and ensure all insurance communications and follow-up efforts are accurately recorded.

Assist with submitting corrected claims, appeals, and additional documentation when necessary.

Ensure insurance payments are posted accurately and unresolved balances are properly addressed.

Collaborate with billing, administrative, and clinical teams to resolve insurance-related issues.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase collections, and enhance overall billing efficiency.

Leadership Responsibilities

Supervise and support insurance billing staff to ensure department expectations are met.

Conduct regular reviews of team productivity, claim follow-up activity, and outstanding insurance balances.

Train new team members on insurance billing procedures, systems, and best practices.

Serve as a resource for team members when complex insurance issues arise.

Promote accountability, organization, and consistent follow-through within the department.

Qualifications

Previous experience in dental insurance billing, healthcare revenue cycle management, or a related field required.

Prior experience leading, supervising, or mentoring a billing team strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of dental insurance processes, claim submission requirements, and insurance terminology.

Proven ability to manage claims from submission through completion with consistent follow-up.

Experience handling denied claims, appeals, insurance correspondence, and claim resolution.

Excellent spoken and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with insurance representatives, patients, and internal team members.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple accounts and deadlines.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to research and resolve complex billing issues.

Ability to work independently while also providing leadership and support to a team.

Experience with dental billing software, electronic claim systems, and insurance portals preferred.



We are a growing company that currently has about 40 people working on our team in the Philippines. In order to know that you read the full message, can you please start your reply message with the word "sunshine".



The ideal candidate is a proactive leader who understands that successful insurance billing requires ownership, organization, and consistent follow-through. This individual should be comfortable managing their own workload while also overseeing a team, identifying areas for improvement, supporting staff development, and ensuring insurance claims continue moving forward until they are fully processed and resolved.

Because this position requires frequent communication with insurance carriers, the ideal candidate must possess excellent spoken and written English communication skills and be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently during phone conversations and written correspondence. Strong communication is essential for building productive relationships with insurance representatives and efficiently resolving claim issues.
salary: $5 per hour with room to grow

title: Shopify Product Lister Specialist
description:
📋SUMMARY



We need a Shopify product lister for Q4 — and beyond.



Products arrive already researched and sourced. You turn each one into a finished product page: import it, clean the imported mess, price it from our cost figure, build the specs, set the variants, assign our page template, configure the backend, set up reviews, and QA it on your phone before it goes live. Then you log it in our Google Sheet so the next person can pick it up.



You don't write copy and you don't make images — we have people for both.



🎄 Why This Q4 Matters



We donate a percentage of this season's profit to a charity that gets Christmas gifts to kids whose parents can't afford them. More products live and converting means more gifts. You won't feel that in every spreadsheet row, but it's why we care that the work is done properly instead of fast and sloppy.



🧠 What We're Looking For



✦ You have built real Shopify product pages before — send links to pages you built (proof of work)

✦ You know your way around the Shopify theme editor: duplicating templates, assigning them, placing sections

✦ You have imported products with an importer app and cleaned up the mess it leaves behind

✦ You have handled product reviews before — bulk import, not one at a time

✦ You know landed cost, markup and margin. You never price a product without knowing what it costs us

✦ Strong written US English — you're not writing copy, you're fixing broken imported text and formatting it

✦ Mobile first. 99% of our visitors arrive from Instagram and
 ads on a phone

✦ You work fast without getting sloppy. Q4 is a volume season, and a rushed page costs us more than a slow one

✦ Reliable and organized — we should not have to double-check your work

✦ You follow a written SOP exactly, and you tell us when a step in it is wrong so we can fix it



🧰 Tools You'll Work In Daily



✦ Shopify admin + theme editor

✦ A product import app

✦ A review import app

✦ Google Sheets (our product tracker) and Google Drive

✦ AI assistant for conversions and formatting

✦ Group chat for daily communication



🛠 Your Main Tasks



✦ Import the product and strip everything unusable — leftover branding, broken characters, non-English text, claims we can't back

✦ Price it from our cost figure using our markup and discount rules, then get the price approved

✦ Build the page to the SOP: specs, "what's in the box", US units (inches / oz / lbs)

✦ Set up variants — right image per variant, no duplicates, short list

✦ Duplicate and assign our page template, then log the link

✦ Configure the backend: inventory, tax, sales channels, handle, SEO, product status

✦ Set up the product reviews and place the review widget

✦ QA the live page on your own phone — variants, buttons, cart, upsells, checkout

✦ Log every product in our sheet and move it to the next status so the rest of the team knows it's their turn



📚 What You Get From Us



A written step-by-step SOP with screenshots for every phase of this job, including our pricing rules, our backend settings and our review process. You are not guessing what "done" means — it is written down. The first products are done together with us so you get our standards in your hands, then you run on your own.



💰 Pay



Hourly. We don't post a fixed rate because it depends on your experience and speed — tell us your hourly rate in your proposal and we'll discuss it on the interview call. Quote what you actually want to work for; we'd rather agree on a fair number once than renegotiate in November.



No maximum hours. Our researcher is sourcing products constantly, so the list refills faster than it empties. The limit is how many products you can finish properly per day, not how much work exists.



⏱ Timeline



Starting this week. Q4 is the whole point — we can't start this in November.



🚀 What's Next



Short-term for Q4 to start, with a real chance of ongoing work into 2027 if the work is strong. The people who do this well become the people we build the next season around.



📋 How to Apply



1. Start your proposal with the word LISTED so we know you read this.



2. Send links to 2 live Shopify product pages you built yourself, and tell us in one line what you were responsible for on each.



3. Record a 60–90 second Loom: who you are, and walk us through one product page you built — including what you would fix on it today. No script, phone audio is fine.



4. Answer these three questions in your proposal. Short answers, no essays:



   A) A product imports with 14 variants. Half have no image and the names look like "Red-L-2pcs-CN". What do you do before this page goes live, and what do you delete entirely?



   B) Say a product costs $8.50 landed. What do you sell it for, what compare-at price do you put next to it, and why that compare-at and not a higher one?



   C) The page looks perfect on desktop. Name the first three things you check on your phone — and one thing you have personally seen break on mobile that looked fine on desktop.



5. Which import app and which review app have you worked with before?



6. Your hourly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.



Shortlisted applicants get one paid test product — build it end to end, paid, and it d
 the hire.



⚠️ Only apply if you can show real proof of work on Shopify product pages. We're not training from zero on Shopify. Applications without the Loom and without the questions answered are not reviewed.

SPF, DKIM, DMARC, rDNS and custom tracking-domain setup

Dedicated IP management and warming

Gmail, Microsoft and Yahoo reputation management

Google Postmaster Tools and Microsoft SNDS monitoring

Automated domain, IP and campaign-health monitoring

Bounce, complaint and suppression management

List validation, hygiene and engagement segmentation

Inbox-placement and seed-list testing

Campaign scheduling and volume allocation

Automated workflows based on subscriber engagement

Tracking and reporting dashboards

Troubleshooting sudden inboxing or reputation problems

Creating documented SOPs our team can follow



Experience with tools such as MailWizz, Mautic, PowerMTA, Postal, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, GlockApps, Everest, Inbox Monster, Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, MillionVerifier or comparable systems is valuable.

The Goal



We want to develop a stable, compliant system that can generate and fulfil a substantial daily volume of genuine clicks without constantly damaging domains or IPs.



We understand that no legitimate expert can guarantee a specific inbox rate or immediately produce 20,000 daily clicks. We want someone who can:



Establish our current baseline.

Diagnose the real bottlenecks.

Create a realistic scaling plan.

Implement the infrastructure and automation.

Measure performance by mailbox provider.

Improve results without relying on deceptive practices or temporary tricks.

Who We’re Looking For



You must have genuine, hands-on experience managing high-volume
 infrastructure.



We are not looking for:



General
 copywriters

Basic automation builders

People whose only experience is sending small newsletters

Someone who simply recommends buying more domains

Anyone using spam-filter evasion, fake engagement or other short-term tactics



The right person understands that deliverability is affected by acquisition source, consent, engagement, complaints, list quality, authentication, infrastructure and sending behaviour—not just
 copy.



To Apply



Please answer every question below:



What is the highest legitimate daily
 volume you have personally managed?

Which ESPs, SMTP platforms and mailing systems have you worked with?

Describe one deliverability problem you diagnosed and solved. Include the starting position, what you changed and the measurable result.

How do you monitor Gmail, Microsoft and Yahoo separately?

What information would you need before recommending an infrastructure?

Applications containing vague claims such as “I guarantee 100% inboxing” will be rejected.



Engagement Structure



We would prefer to begin with a paid technical audit and implementation plan.



If your diagnosis is strong and you can demonstrate the required experience, this can become a substantial implementation and ongoing management contract.

title: Creative Designer | Product Page Images & Static Ads
description:
📋SUMMARY



We need a creative designer for Q4 — and beyond.



We test a lot of products fast. Every product that comes to you is already researched, sourced and listed. Your job is to make it sell visually, and you deliver two things per product:



1. The product page image set — the product page gallery a visitor scrolls through.

2. A batch of static ads — 3 to 6 image ads, each with a different hook, built to stop a scroll in the
 and Instagram feed.



*Page images explain to someone already interested. 

*Ads have to earn the click from a stranger without clickbaiting.



This is a design role with a copywriting half. You get a market research document and approved page copy for every product, and you write the short copy that goes on the images yourself — the headline, the benefit line, the feature line. We're not asking you to write the product page. We are asking you to pull the right desire out of a research doc and say it in eight words on an image.



You don't edit video — we have someone for that.



🎄 Why This Q4 Matters



We donate a percentage of this store's profit to a charity that gets Christmas gifts to kids whose parents can't afford them. It's why we care that the work is done properly and fast.



🧠 What We're Looking For



✦ A lot of experience designing e-commerce product images and static ads — this is the core of the role.

✦ Strong Canva skills. You work inside an existing brand template without breaking it

✦ You can write the copy that goes on your designs — headlines, benefit lines, hooks, in the customer's words

✦ You can read a market research document and find the desire that actually makes someone buy

✦ You mastered AI generative tools

✦ Mobile first, and fast. 99% of our traffic is on a phone, and Q4 is a volume season



🧰 Tools You'll Work In Daily



✦ Canva (our brand templates live there)

✦ Higgsfield for AI tools

✦ Google Drive — research documents, source material and deliverables

✦ 
 — where we feedback each version

✦ Google Sheets — our product tracker

✦ 
 for daily communication



🛠 Your Main Tasks



✦ Read the research and the live product page, then d
 the angle

✦ Write the image copy: main benefit, supporting feature, a different hook per ad

✦ Build the product page image set in our Canva template

✦ Build the static ad batch

✦ Source and improve the visuals with AI, generating new product-in-use shots where nothing usable exists

✦ Deliver into our folders, process feedback into new versions, and log what you built



📚 What You Get From Us



A written step-by-step SOP with screenshots covering every phase of this role — the template structure, the copy hierarchy on each image, the naming conventions, the review process. You are not guessing what "done" means. A full market research document and approved page copy come with every product, so you always know who the buyer is and what they want before you write a word. The first product is done together with us.



💰 Pay



✦ Hourly — rate discussed on application. No maximum hours: research runs constantly, so the list refills constantly. The limit is how much you can process accurately.



⏱ Timeline



✦ Starting this week. Q4 is the whole point — we can't start this in November.



🚀 What's Next



✦ Short-term for Q4 to start, with a real chance of ongoing work into 2027 if the work is strong. Designers who prove themselves here get first pick of the next season.



📋 How to Apply



1. Start your proposal with the word CANVA so we know you read this.



2. Send us two things: a product page image set you designed, and a static ad you designed. Tell us in one line what the goal of each was — and confirm whether you wrote the copy on them yourself.



3. Record a 60–90 second Loom: who you are, and how you mastered this skill.



4. Answer this questions in your proposal. Short answers, no essays:



   A) The only usable photo of a product is a blurry screenshot from a competitor's video. Walk us through what you actually do to get a usable image out of it.



5. Which AI image tool have you used, and what did you use it for?



⚠️ Only apply if you can show real product page images and static ads you designed yourself, and you're comfortable writing the copy that goes on them. We're not training from zero on design. Applications without the Loom and without the questions answered are not reviewed.

title: Procurement and Logistics Manager
description:
Procurement & Logistics Manager 



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly analytical, proactive, and hands-on Procurement & Logistics Manager with specialized experience in the Amazon ecosystem (FBA/FBM). In this role, you will oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, from global vendor sourcing and purchase order management to international freight forwarding, 3PL hub management, and inbound distribution into Amazon Fulfillment Centers.



Your primary focus will be maintaining optimal stock levels, protecting inventory health metrics (IPI score), optimizing total landed costs, and building resilient supplier partnerships to support scalable e-commerce growth.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Inventory & FBA Operations Management

Manage daily FBA inventory workflows within Amazon Seller Central (and/or Vendor Central), including shipping plan creation, box content information, pallet specifications, and tracking inbound shipments.

Continuously monitor and optimize Inventory Performance Index (IPI) scores, restock limits, capacity limits, and aged inventory metrics to minimize overage and storage fees while preventing stockouts.

Ensure 100% compliance with Amazon prep, labeling, packaging, and routing requirements to eliminate prep chargebacks, processing delays, or vendor chargebacks.

Coordinate stock transfers between 3PL warehouses and Amazon FCs based on regional velocity, seasonal spikes, and FC receiving lead times.

2. Sourcing, Procurement & Vendor Management

Lead end-to-end purchase order (PO) generation, issuing, and status tracking with overseas and domestic manufacturing partners.

Negotiate pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs), payment terms, and production lead times with suppliers to optimize cash flow and gross margins.

Establish supplier KPI dashboards to evaluate factory performance regarding defect rates, on-time delivery rates, and order fulfillment accuracy.

Identify secondary sourcing options for critical high-velocity SKUs to mitigate single-supplier dependency risks.

3. Global Logistics & Freight Coordination

Oversee international freight forwarding operations (Ocean FCL/LCL, Air Freight, Express Parcel, and DDP/FOB shipments) from factory gates to domestic destinations.

Partner with customs brokers and freight partners to ensure accurate HTS code classification, duty/tariff compliance, and smooth customs clearance.

Calculate, audit, and optimize total landed costs (unit cost + freight + duties + 3PL + Amazon fulfillment fees) to drive bottom-line profitability.

4. Demand Planning & Inventory Forecasting

Build and maintain dynamic demand forecasting models using historical sales velocity, organic search rankings, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events (e.g., Prime Day, Q4 Holiday Season).

Establish target reorder points (ROP), safety stock levels, and replenishment schedules across all product lines.

Perform weekly/monthly inventory reconciliations across Seller Central, 3PL physical stock, and internal ERP/inventory systems.



Qualifications & Skill Requirements



Required Experience

3–5+ years of direct experience in procurement, supply chain, or logistics for an e-commerce brand.

Must have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central (Inbound Shipping Plans, FBA Inventory Dashboard, Inventory Performance Index, Restock Limits).

Proven track record managing international freight logistics (specifically Asia-to-US/EU shipping lanes, customs, and ocean/air freight).

Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions: VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, forecasting models).

Experience working with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and prep centers.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience using supply chain software or ERP tools (e.g., NetSuite, Katana, InventoryLab, RestockPro, or similar).

Knowledge of multi-channel fulfillment models (Walmart Marketplace, Shopify Direct-to-Consumer, TikTok Shop).



How to Apply

Interested candidates should send a message with the subject: “Overqualified for coffee runs, perfect for Procurement and Logistics.” The cover letter should consist of your years of experience related to the job post. Send it together with your resume link.

title: Accounts & Finance Specialist - Own the Entire Finance Function of an Australian Business
description:
Own the entire finance function of an established, profitable Australian consumer products business. All of it - payments, payroll, cashflow, receivables, supplier reconciliation, leave and compliance - plus the analysis on top: forecasting, margin work, supplier negotiation modelling, and the numbers the directors use to make decisions.



You are not on your own. An outsourced partner handles the bookkeeping and provides a financial controller. But you are the finance function inside the business, and you report straight to a director.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗷𝗼𝗯 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲



About 60% is the rhythm that keeps the business running. Payments most mornings, cashflow updated, payroll every fortnight, reconciliation weekly, month-end monthly. Get it right, get it out on time - a lot of people downstream are waiting on you.



About 30% is working things out. Why is our shipping costing more than we charge for it? What is that supplier rebate really worth before we agree to it? How has this cost been sitting in the wrong account for a year? Which week are we going to be tight, and how early can we see it coming?



The last 10% is making the first 60% smaller and better. Cutting steps out of a process, automating what a machine should be doing, and spending the time you win back on quality.



We have a technical contractor who will build whatever you specify. You will not automate all of it and we are not expecting that - but if you make a daily task disappear, that is a win, and we will not quietly fill the time with something else.



Each part feeds the others - you spot the odd number because you did the reconciliation yourself. The people who do well here want all three: clean books, numbers they actually understand, and something in the business working better because of what they found and then did about it.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲



We are a team of 18 across Australia and the Philippines. Our Philippine team has been the operational backbone of this business for years - not a support function, the people who run it day to day.



We hold a high standard on the work rather than on hours at a desk, and we back your decisions.



The flip side is that we are direct. You will get clear feedback, and we expect the same back. You can raise a mistake, say you are not sure, or tell a director they are wrong, and none of those cost you anything here. What does not work is quietly letting something slide.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗼𝘄𝗻



• The daily payment cycle, supplier coordination, receivables and refunds



• Fortnightly payroll submission, with our outsourced bookkeeping team processing the run



• Cashflow forecasting - maintaining it, improving it, and flagging problems before they arrive



• Warranty claim finance with our main supplier, including reconciliation and claim modelling



• Month-end close, the monthly finance report, and the metrics on it



• Leave records, compliance renewals, and software subscription costs



• The relationship with our outsourced finance partner - you run it, not us



• Whatever analysis a director needs, and the analysis nobody asked for but should have



𝗥𝗼𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗼 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁: some of the financial controller work currently sits with our external partner. If you have the capability, there is scope to bring more of that in-house over time.



𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝗳



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗴𝗲𝘁 𝘂𝗽 𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝘁. You are stepping into an established function rather than building one from scratch. We are looking for someone who can be genuinely self-sufficient within a few weeks, not a few months.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗱𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀. Given a call that sits inside your remit, you make it and tell us what you did - rather than writing up the options and waiting.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲. When someone owes you something and the date passes, you follow up the next day, without agonising about whether they will find it annoying. This matters more in this role than almost anything else.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗴𝗼 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴. The best work in this seat comes from noticing something odd in the numbers and following it before anyone asks you to.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀. Including the documentation, which is the part everyone skips.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗳𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗱 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗴, and explaining why.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆. Most of how we work is written, and clarity beats volume.



𝗢𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿 𝗼𝗻. There is no finance team - you will have colleagues across the business, but you are the only person in this seat.

• 3+ years owning a finance or accounts function in a real operating business - not a bookkeeping seat inside a larger finance team, and not high-volume BPO processing



• Comfortable across a P&L, a balance sheet and a cashflow forecast - not just producing them, but reading them and knowing what a movement actually means



• Genuinely strong with spreadsheets - you build models, not just maintain them. Multi-scenario cashflow, sensitivity, reconciliation across systems.



• Payroll experience, and enough confidence to audit historical payroll records and find errors in them



• Experience working with an external bookkeeper or accountant, and holding them to dates



• Xero or equivalent; Notion or equivalent at builder level; a workflow automation tool (Zapier, Make, n8n) as a genuine user



• 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝘀 𝗮𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸. You use it to move faster on analysis, process design and writing, and you edit and pressure-test what comes back. We want people who use AI to raise their output, not to paper over gaps in it.



• Written English at business-professional standard



• Standard hours 9am-6pm AEST/AEDT



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝗶𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘆𝗼𝘂

• 20 days Annual Leave and 10 days Sick/Carer's Leave



• Seven Philippine public holidays awarded as paid days off on top of that leave - Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Labor Day, Independence Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and Rizal Day. Any other holiday you take off comes from your annual leave balance.

6. 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿



We will come back to you either way within five business days. We are looking to fill this quickly, so if you can start soon, say so - it genuinely counts in your favour.
