title: Technical GHL & Client Success Specialist (Future Operations Manager)
description:
Company: Automated Service Company

Location: Remote (Agency based in New York Region, USA)

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: $5.00 – $8.00 / hour + Guaranteed Pay Increases + Guaranteed Performance Bonuses + Health Allowance + PTO

________________________________________

About Us & Career Growth Path



We are a fast-growing automation agency based in the New York Region, USA. We build and integrate 24/7 AI Voice Receptionists, After-Hours Phone Dispatchers, and Automated SMS Booking Setters for local home service companies (plumbers, roofers, HVAC contractors).

We are expanding our core tech stack to GoHighLevel (GHL) to run our entire fulfillment operation. We are looking for a highly motivated, technically elite GHL & Client Success Specialist to join our team immediately on a full-time basis.

Future Operations Manager Path: This is a long-term position with massive growth potential. You will work directly with the founder to manage our clients and systems. As our agency scales past 15-20 clients, this role is designed to move quickly into the Operations Manager position, where you will eventually lead, hire, and manage a team of 2 additional virtual assistants using the systems you help document.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities



Operations & Documentation (SOP Management)

• SOP Creation: Document, create, and refine clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for client configurations, tech setups, and daily maintenance routines.

• Organization & Filing: Label, categorize, and file all company SOPs in a centralized knowledge base (e.g., Notion, Google Drive, or ClickUp) to ensure the business is structured for easy team training.



Client Support & Onboarding (Phone &
)

• Client Success & Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for clients via phone and
 to handle onboarding, account inquiries, and technical support requests.

• Requirements Gathering: Consult directly with clients to map out their specific business workflows, scheduling needs, and CRM service requirements.



GoHighLevel Account Setup & Tech Fulfillment

• Sub-Account Configuration: Set up and manage client sub-accounts inside GHL, including loading snapshots, configuring business profiles, custom fields, calendars, and pipelines.

• Telephony & A2P Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot LC Phone/SMS settings, phone numbers, dedicated
 subdomains, and strict A2P compliance.

• Missed-Call Text-Back: Build and test immediate SMS auto-replies in GHL to capture inbound leads when clients miss a phone call.

• Reputation Management: Set up automated Google Review request workflows via SMS and
 triggered after successful service delivery.

• WiFi Client Capture: Integrate GHL forms and workflows with local business WiFi hardware to automatically capture lead data (names,
s, phones) when customers log in.

• AI & Workflow Integration: Build automated workflows in 
 and GHL to connect text-based AI booking agents and conversational Voice AI systems into client tools (Google Calendar, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro).

• Voice AI System Configuration: Configure, train, and test conversational Voice AI phone agents inside GHL, managing advanced phone routing, call-transfer logic, and missed-call text-back triggers.



Lead Generation Support

• Lead Scraping: Use tools like Lead Scrape or manual research to scrape local business data from Google Maps to fuel our cold outreach.

• Database Management: Keep lead databases perfectly organized in Google Sheets and track daily outbound
 metrics.

________________________________________

Compensation & Benefits



• Base Salary: $5.00 – $8.00 / hour (Paid based on experience and onboarding speed).

• Guaranteed Pay Increases: Structured hourly rate bumps built into your contract upon passing your 90-day review and tracking with long-term performance milestones.

• Guaranteed Bonuses: Fixed cash performance bonuses awarded for successful technical milestones and active client account retention.

• Health Insurance Allowance: A guaranteed monthly health allowance is provided within your first 6 months of employment to cover your private HMO or PhilHealth costs.

• Paid Time Off (PTO): Full PTO benefits unlocked automatically after your first 6 months of employment.

________________________________________

Required Qualifications & Skills



• OnlineJobs.ph Verification: An ID Proof Score of 70 or higher is strongly preferred to ensure an established, verified account history.

• Advanced GoHighLevel (GHL) Experience: Deep, hands-on knowledge of GHL sub-accounts, workflows, custom values, calendars, and phone settings is mandatory.

• A2P 10DLC Compliance: Strong familiarity with setting up and troubleshooting A2P registration inside GHL is a BIG PLUS. You should know how to get brand and campaign registrations approved quickly to avoid SMS filtering.

• Process-Oriented Thinking: Proven ability to explain complex technical setups clearly through written guides or recorded video walkthroughs (Loom).

• Exceptional English (Spoken & Written): You will talk directly to US-based contractors over the phone and
, as well as test voice AI systems. Flawless communication is required.

• Telephony & API Logic: Strong understanding of webhooks, JSON data mapping, and phone routing (Twilio, call forwarding, bridging). Experience with Voice AI automation inside GHL is a massive plus.

• High Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for typos, broken automation paths, or messy databases.

________________________________________

How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)



We receive a massive amount of automated applications. To prove you actually read this and possess the attention to detail required for an Operations Manager role, you must follow these steps:



1. Change the subject line of your application message to exactly: "GHL Specialist for Hire" (Any application without this exact subject line will be deleted instantly).



2. Include a screenshot of your internet speed from Speedtest.net.



3. Provide a brief summary answering these three things:

- A specific GoHighLevel setup or 
 workflow you built that you are proud of (bonus points if you have built a Missed-Call Text-Back or Google Review workflow before).

- Your experience handling client support via phone and
.

- Your experience (if any) creating technical SOPs or training guides for software.

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

Participate in occasional weekend number-reporting for urgent, higher-spend campaigns (numbers only, with advance heads-up — not full optimisation)

You’ll receive priorities and inputs directly from the founder and account manager — no stakeholder chaos. Our VA handles the admin so you can stay on performance.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

Writing scripts or designing creatives (we have a scriptwriter, video editor and carousel designer)

Client communication or account management

Redesigning offers or pricing

Juggling 50–100 accounts — we are a high-value, low-volume agency and will add buyers before overloading you

Your focus is campaign performance and health, with clear boundaries and structure.

Who This Role Is For

This role is a good fit if you:

Have hands-on experience running conversion ads (leads or sales) on Meta — not branding or awareness

Think in cost per lead, CPC, CTR and ROAS, and can explain why you scale, pause or kill an ad

Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move fast

Respect structure but don’t freeze when conditions change

Communicate clearly, report proactively and take ownership seriously

Are ready to commit full-time to one team and grow with it



Who This Role Is NOT For

“Set-and-forget” ad managers who report once a week

Freelancers juggling multiple clients or running their own agency on the side

People who only want to run brand awareness or big-budget branding campaigns

Anyone uncomfortable with responsibility tied to real client spend



How We Work

At Restive Collective, you are judged on results delivered, not hours clocked.

Results-driven \u2014 what matters is your campaigns\u2019 numbers \u2014 cost per lead, lead volume and campaign health \u2014 and how proactively you report and act on them

Systems-led \u2014 clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA so you can focus on your actual craft

Small, focused team \u2014 you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management



Compensation & Growth

SGD 800 – 1,200 / month, depending on experience

Clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA supporting you so you can focus on performance

A growth path to Senior Media Buyer — as we add clients you’ll mentor the next buyer, help build our media-buying SOPs and shape how the agency scales

Exposure to funnels, WhatsApp automation and landing pages — grow beyond ads into full-funnel thinking

If you’re looking for a comfortable, low-pressure role, this isn’t it.

If you’re looking to own performance and grow with a young agency, you’ll thrive here.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. The questions are designed to understand how you think, not just what tools you’ve used.



👉 Apply here: 
  



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.







Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for a media buyer who:

Respects structure

Protects campaign performance

Takes ownership seriously

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you

The founder has built an Uber competitor focused on a fairer ride-hailing experience for drivers and is involved in a UK property portfolio worth millions of pounds. This role provides the opportunity to learn directly from **20 years of business experience** across entrepreneurship, sales, marketing, property, and business development.



This is more than a traditional PA role. The right person could develop into a trusted long-term team member, help manage future teams, and potentially become a future business partner.



## Main Responsibilities



- Develop and grow one Instagram page.

- Create professional designs, carousels, captions, and presentations build audience.

- Build trust, engagement, brand awareness, and valuable connections.

- Support personal administration, research, scheduling, and follow-ups.

- Assist with sales outreach, lead generation, and property-related research.

- Learn about property sales, business development, and client relationships.

- Use AI tools, design software, presentations, no-code platforms, and light coding.

- Take initiative and contribute ideas to improve the business.



## Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- Ambitious and genuinely interested in Sales, marketing, property, and entrepreneurship.

- A quick learner with a continuous-learning mindset.

- Business minded perspective with Potential to start new ventures and businesses.

- Confident, proactive, organised, and comfortable building relationships.

- Passionate about marketing and understands how to create trust through content.

- Able to demonstrate Instagram, design, sales, or communication experience.

- Comfortable using Canva, AI tools,  presentation software, light AI coding, and digital platforms.

- Interested in developing into a leadership or business-development role.

- Serious about building a long-term professional future.



Previous property experience is helpful but not essential. Attitude, initiative, communication, and willingness to learn are equally important.



## What We Offer



- A **two-month paid internship with the possibility of long-term employment** during trainings.

- Direct mentoring and support from an entrepreneur with 20 years of business experience.

- Continuous learning, training, and relevant courses.

- With uncapped commission structure possibility to earn without a limit

- Practical experience in Instagram marketing, sales, property, business, and entrepreneurship.

- **Uncapped commission on successful property sales and rentals**.

- The opportunity to develop and manage a future team.

- Potential relocation opportunities for the right person, depending on performance, business growth, and eligibility.

- The possibility of progressing beyond a PA role into a senior position or future business partnership.



Any long-term role, relocation opportunity, leadership position, commission arrangement, or partnership will depend on performance, trust, results, commitment, and business development.



## Application Question



Please Fill the application form to apply;







- Examples of Instagram success, design, sales history, or marketing work.

- A short explanation of what you would aim to achieve in your first 30 days.

- The tools you use, including AI and design platforms.

- Your availability and salary expectations.

- An example of when you took initiative or taught yourself a new skill.

Minimum Qualifications

• Power BI, Looker Studio or similar dashboard tools

• SQL, APIs, integrations and data cleaning

• Make, n8n, Zapier or similar automation platforms

• KPI definition and data validation

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to work independently and proactively

• Clear documentation and communication



Basic Python experience is helpful, but we value business understanding, accuracy, ownership and simplicity more than complicated technology.



INITIAL PRIORITIES



1. Understand our systems, data and business goals

2. Define consistent KPIs and identify data-quality issues

3. Build a simple, reliable management dashboard

4. Automate recurring reporting and manual data tasks

5. Recommend further opportunities for automation and growth



CONTRACT DETAILS



• Independent contractor—not an employee

• Approximately 20 hours per week

• Fully remote

• Long-term opportunity

• Monthly compensation of $500–$1,000 USD depending on experience with possibility for a later full-time role.

• Contractor agreement and monthly payment managed through Deel

• Potential for increased hours and responsibility over time



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Two or three dashboards, integrations, reporting solutions or internal tools you personally built. Screenshots, links or a short recorded walkthrough are welcome.

2. A short explanation of your personal contribution, technologies used and business outcome for each example.

3. One example of how you identified a data-quality issue or generated a useful business insight.

4. A brief outline of how you would approach your first 60–90 days with us.

5. Your expected monthly compensation and current availability.



Please begin your application with “RESET DATA” so we know you have read the complete job description.



We are looking for an individual contractor, not an agency.

title: Social Media Manager/Growth Expert
description:
Harder Than Life is a podcast and personal brand built by me, Kelly Siegel. I'm an entrepreneur who has bought and rebuilt companies, failed plenty, and built the show around one idea: you are not your story. The audience is high-performing people who keep hitting the same ceiling and are ready to hear the hard truth about why. Two episodes a week (a guest interview and a solo episode), plus books and speaking.



I'm hiring one person to own TikTok, Instagram, and
 for this brand. You cut the clips, you write the hooks and captions, you post, you engage, and you grow the audience. You are judged on two numbers: net new followers per month across the three platforms, and clicks pushed off-platform to podcast episodes and the
 list. Views are the means, not the end.



What you will do every day



Watch each new full-length episode and pull the 8 to 12 strongest moments: the hard truths, the stories, the lines that make someone stop scrolling.

Edit vertical clips in CapCut or Premiere with punchy hooks in the first two seconds, clean captions, tight cuts, and a consistent HTL look. You'll get brand assets and examples. You are expected to match them, then make them better.

Post daily on TikTok and Instagram (Reels, plus carousels and quote cards) and cross-post to
, with captions and hooks written in my voice: blunt, warm, zero fluff, no motivational-poster language.

Put a clear call to action on every post that points to the full episode or the
 list, and track which clips actually drive clicks.

Reply to every comment and DM within a few hours during US Eastern daytime. Start conversations in the comments of accounts our audience already follows.

Study what's working in the personal development, entrepreneurship, and podcast-clip space every week and bring me two tests to run. Then run them and report what happened.

Send me a weekly scorecard: followers gained per platform, views, saves and shares, profile visits, link clicks to episodes and
 signups, top three clips and why they worked, and what you're changing next week.



What I expect from you



You own the numbers. A bad week gets a straight explanation with data and a plan, not an excuse.

You can show me short-form accounts you have grown, with the before and after. Podcast clipping experience is a strong plus.

You're fast and clean in CapCut or Premiere and know how to caption, hook, and pace for TikTok and Reels specifically, not just resize a horizontal video.

You write natural English and can hear the difference between my voice and generic influencer copy.

You work most of your day on US Eastern time so posting and engagement land when the audience is awake.

You test, fail, learn, and try again. That's how this brand works and it's how this job works. Failing the same way twice without learning from it is the one thing that isn't acceptable.



What you get



Direct access to the owner. No agency layers, fast feedback, real creative input.

Clear targets, honest coaching, and a monthly bonus tied to follower growth and link clicks.

A long-term seat on a brand that publishes twice a week, every week, so you'll never be short on material.

title: TikTok Shop Creator Growth & Affiliate Manager — US & UK
description:
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded TikTok Shop Creator Growth & Affiliate Manager to help scale creator-driven growth across the US and UK markets.



This is **not a purely administrative outreach role**. You will be expected to understand what drives GMV, identify growth bottlenecks, develop creator and content strategies, and build a repeatable system that turns creator partnerships into revenue.



Key Responsibilities



- Develop and execute TikTok Shop affiliate and creator growth strategies across the US and UK.

- Analyze performance data to identify winning creator profiles, content angles, products, offers, and growth opportunities.

- Build a structured creator pipeline covering recruitment, segmentation, activation, relationship management, reactivation, and retention.

- Translate performance insights into clearer creator briefs, content recommendations, incentive structures, and testing plans.

- Work closely with internal team members and external partners, setting priorities and improving execution quality rather than simply doing high-volume outreach.

- Build SOPs, reporting systems, and scalable workflows while taking ownership of relevant ad hoc growth projects.



Requirements



- Proven experience growing TikTok Shop, affiliate, influencer, or creator-led revenue in the US or UK market.

- Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect creator activity, content performance, conversion, and GMV.

- Able to think strategically while remaining hands-on enough to diagnose problems and drive execution.

- Experience with creator segmentation, outreach systems, seeding, incentives, content feedback, and performance analysis.

- Strong written and spoken English, with clear communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Experience in beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness, fashion, or another creator-led consumer category is a strong advantage.



What Success Looks Like



You build a repeatable creator-growth engine—not just a larger contact list. Success will be evaluated through improvements in creator activation, productive creator rate, content output, winning content volume, GMV, and overall commercial efficiency.



Compensation: competitive base plus a meaningful performance bonus tied to agreed creator-growth and commercial outcomes.



How to Apply (PLEASE FOLLOW EXACTLY AS BELOW - OTHERWISE WILL BE IGNORED)



Please include:



- Your CV 

- TikTok Shop markets, categories, and brands/agencies you have worked with

- Your specific responsibilities and measurable results, including GMV where possible

title: Performance Graphic Designer — Static Ads
description:
Please attach your portfolio and indicate roughly how many finished static ads you can produce per working day. Please distinguish between net-new concepts, meaningful variations, and simple resizes.



We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising—not general branding or organic social design. You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.



Key Responsibilities



- Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

- Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

- Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

- Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

- Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

- Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



Requirements



- Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

- Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

- Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently—not just copy references mechanically.

- Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

- Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

- Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

- Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

- Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

- Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus.



How to Apply (ANYONE NOT FOLLOWING THIS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED)



Please include:



- Your portfolio link, preferably with direct-response static ads.

- Any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands you have worked with, plus relevant work links.

- Your CV, current availability, and expected monthly salary.

- The design and AI tools you regularly use.

- From a clear brief with assets provided, how many **net-new static concepts** and **meaningful variations** can you normally produce per working day? Please do not count simple resizes as new creatives.

- How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

- Briefly explain how you would iterate one winning static ad into multiple genuinely different variations.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: U.S. Tax Accountant — Remote
description:
Part-Time Ramp-Up to Full-Time | Future Tax Advisor Opportunity



Company: Phaenix Advisory

Compensation: Up to USD $1,000 per month, based on experience

Start date: October or November 2026

Term: Part-Time Oct-December, Full-time through May 2027, with the possibility of becoming a permanent position

Schedule: At least 4–5 working hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



About the role

Phaenix Advisory is seeking an experienced U.S. Tax Accountant to join us initially on a part-time basis beginning in October 2026. From October through December, the successful candidate will learn our business, clients, systems, tax processes, and quality standards. This ramp-up period will include training, reviewing prior-year returns, becoming familiar with our real-estate clients, and working in our technology stack, including ProConnect and TaxDome.



The position will transition to full-time from January through May 2027 for the U.S. tax season. Strong performance may lead to a permanent, long-term position with increasing client responsibility and the opportunity to grow into a tax advisor role.

This is a hands-on tax role for someone who can prepare accurate returns, identify missing or inconsistent information, maintain organized workpapers, and communicate clearly with reviewers and clients. We are looking for more than a data-entry tax preparer: the right person will demonstrate sound judgment, take ownership of their work, and have the potential to grow into a client-facing tax advisor.



What you’ll do

- Prepare U.S. federal and state income tax returns for individuals and businesses.

- Work on tax returns involving rental properties and real-estate investors.

- Review client documents and identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable information.

- Prepare clear, organized workpapers and completion notes.

- Research routine U.S. tax questions and present your findings clearly.

- Respond to review comments accurately and avoid repeating corrected mistakes.

- Communicate professionally with the team and, as the role develops, directly with clients.

- Help improve tax-preparation checklists, templates, and internal workflows.

- Gradually develop the judgment and communication skills needed to support tax planning and advisory work.

Required qualifications

- At least three years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience.

- Practical experience preparing tax returns

- Strong understanding of U.S. individual and business taxation.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accurate work.

- Ability to investigate issues, form a reasonable conclusion, and ask focused questions when review is needed.

- Ability to work full-time with at least 4–5 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time.

- Reliable, strong internet connection and a professional remote-work environment.

- Ability to manage deadlines and work independently in a remote setting.



Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Intuit ProConnect Tax & TaxDome

- Experience with Forms 1040, 1065, and 1120-S, including Schedule E, depreciation, and property dispositions.

- Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients.

- Experience supporting tax planning or explaining tax matters in plain English.

- Thoughtful use of approved AI tools for research, drafting, documentation, or workflow improvement.

- Understanding of the need to verify AI-generated work and protect confidential client information.



What success looks like

A successful candidate will produce accurate, well-supported work, raise issues early, and make review easy. Over time, this person should require less supervision, communicate confidently with clients, and develop from a strong tax preparer into a trusted tax advisor.



How to apply

Please submit your résumé and answer the following questions:

1. How many years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience do you have?

2. Which U.S. tax returns and forms have you personally prepared?

3. Describe your experience preparing returns for real-estate investors or rental-property owners.

4. Which professional tax software have you used, and for how long?

5. Can you work full-time with at least 4–5 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific Time?

6. Describe one tax issue you identified that was not obvious from the client’s documents. What did you do?

7. How have you used AI in tax or accounting work, and how did you verify the output?

title: Outbound Insurance Sales Representative – Home & Auto (Philippines, Remote)
description:
Title: Outbound Insurance Sales Representative – Home & Auto (Philippines, Remote)



Company: Stable Wealth Strategies Corp. (Allstate Agency)



Location: Remote – Philippines



Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, aligned to U.S. business hours (specify Eastern or your local time zone)



About the Role

Stable Wealth Strategies Corp., an Allstate agency serving clients in Ohio, is hiring an outbound telemarketer to call warm/cold leads, qualify their interest in home and auto insurance, and live-transfer qualified prospects to a licensed agent for quoting. This is a high-volume, phone-first role — you won't be quoting or binding policies yourself, but you'll be the first voice prospects hear and the gatekeeper for lead quality.



Key Responsibilities



Place outbound calls to a provided lead list (200+ dials/day expected)

Follow a structured script to introduce Stable Wealth Strategies and Allstate home/auto products

Qualify leads by confirming: property ownership/vehicle ownership, current insurance status, renewal date, coverage interest, and contact eligibility

Handle basic objections and re-engage lukewarm leads

Live-transfer qualified, interested leads directly to a licensed agent for quoting

Log every call outcome, disposition, and note in the CRM/dialer

Meet daily/weekly KPIs for dials, talk time, qualified transfers, and connect rate

Maintain compliance with call scripts, do-not-call lists, and TCPA-adjacent calling practices



Qualifications



1+ years of outbound telemarketing, appointment-setting, or insurance/financial services cold-calling experience (U.S. market experience strongly preferred)

Excellent spoken English — clear, neutral-to-American accent, confident phone presence

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; resilient, coachable, competitive

Experience with a dialer/CRM (e.g., HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Five9, RingCentral) a plus

Insurance industry familiarity (auto/home/P&C) a plus but not required — training provided

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power, quiet home office or access to a BPO seat

Own headset/computer meeting minimum specs (if remote/home-based)



Compensation Structure (suggested)



Base hourly rate + per-qualified-transfer bonus + optional bonus for transfers that convert to a bound policy

This blended structure is standard in Philippines outbound sales and keeps agents motivated to send quality transfers, not just volume
